attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center affected by this risk, if the risk is DC-specific. Links to the distribution facility master data for logistics continuity planning.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant affected by this risk, if the risk is plant-specific. Links to the plant master data for production continuity planning.

attributes.name: primary_risk_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier associated with this risk, if the risk is supplier-specific. Links to the supplier master data for vendor risk management.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: risk_register should be tied to a specific network node for risk tracking; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: tertiary_risk_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this risk record in the system, linking to the workforce master data for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the risk was closed or fully mitigated, enabling risk resolution cycle time analysis and mitigation effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: affected_node_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of supply network node identifiers (plants, distribution centers, suppliers) that are exposed to this risk, supporting network resilience analysis.

attributes.name: affected_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU identifiers that are exposed to this supply chain risk, enabling product-level impact analysis and mitigation planning.

attributes.name: assessed_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment (probability and impact scoring) was completed, establishing the baseline for risk monitoring.

attributes.name: contingency_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated financial cost of implementing the contingency plan, including expedited freight, alternative sourcing premiums, and safety stock carrying costs, measured in the base currency.

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Reactive response plan to be executed if the risk materializes, including alternative sourcing strategies, safety stock deployment, and business continuity procedures.

attributes.name: contingency_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Additional safety stock quantity recommended to buffer against this risk, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used for inventory optimization and DRP planning.

attributes.name: contingency_stock_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the contingency stock quantity (e.g., EA, CS, KG, LB), aligned with the SKU base UOM for consistency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk record was first created in the system, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this risk record (impact_score, contingency_cost_estimate).

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Score indicating the quality of the data record

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was escalated to higher management levels, tracking the escalation timeline for governance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this risk has been escalated to senior management or executive leadership due to high severity or strategic importance.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country code where the risk is localized, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional identifiers for geopolitical and natural disaster risk tracking.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply chain risk was first identified and entered into the risk register, supporting risk aging and trend analysis.

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: Quantitative financial estimate of potential loss or cost if the risk event occurs, measured in the base currency. Used for risk prioritization and contingency budget planning.

attributes.name: impact_severity
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential business impact if the risk materializes: critical (business-threatening), high (major disruption), medium (moderate impact), low (minor inconvenience), or negligible (minimal effect).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk record, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX, enabling change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent risk review or reassessment, ensuring risks are periodically evaluated as part of the S&OP and IBP governance process.

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the proactive actions and controls implemented to reduce the probability or impact of the risk, including timelines and responsible parties.

attributes.name: mitigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when mitigation activities commenced, tracking the timeline of risk response execution.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next risk review or reassessment, supporting proactive risk management and compliance with review frequency policies.

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative assessment of the likelihood that the risk event will occur, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00) based on historical data, expert judgment, and predictive analytics.

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: Source system or process that created this record

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the supply chain risk type: supplier (vendor failure, capacity constraints), logistics (transportation disruption, port delays), geopolitical (trade restrictions, political instability), regulatory (compliance changes, import/export restrictions), natural_disaster (weather events, earthquakes, pandemics), or quality (product defects, contamination).

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the supply chain risk, including context, potential triggers, and business impact scenarios.

attributes.name: risk_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, updates, or observations related to the risk, supporting collaborative risk management and knowledge sharing.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the supply chain risk, formatted as RISK-NNNNNNNN for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk rating calculated as probability_score multiplied by impact_score, used for risk ranking and prioritization in the S&OP and IBP processes.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk: identified (newly discovered), assessed (analysis complete), active (currently impacting operations), mitigated (controls in place), closed (no longer a threat), or monitoring (under observation).

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the primary risk category for more precise risk segmentation and analysis.

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the nature of the supply chain risk for quick identification and reporting.

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the risk is expected to be fully mitigated or closed, used for risk management performance tracking and SLA monitoring.

products.name: planning_exception
products.description: Transactional record capturing supply planning exceptions and alerts generated during IBP supply planning and DRP execution runs. Stores exception type (OOS risk, excess inventory, late replenishment, unmet demand, capacity breach), affected SKU/location, exception severity, exception date, recommended action, planner assignment, resolution status, resolution notes, and originating run reference. Drives exception-based planning workflows and planner workbench prioritization.

attributes.name: planning_exception_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planning exception record. Primary key for the planning exception entity.

attributes.name: primary_planning_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planner or demand planner assigned to resolve this exception.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU affected by this planning exception.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant, distribution center, or location where the planning exception occurred.

attributes.name: tertiary_planning_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the planning exception record.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recommended action type for resolving the exception. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: expedite_order|cancel_order|increase_production|decrease_production|transfer_stock|adjust_forecast|override_plan — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auto_resolution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception was automatically resolved by the system without planner intervention.

attributes.name: business_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the exception if not resolved, expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Type of supply chain constraint that contributed to the planning exception.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the planning exception record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the business impact amount.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Score indicating the quality of the data record

attributes.name: demand_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: The forecasted demand quantity for the affected SKU-location during the exception period.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exception was escalated to management or cross-functional teams for resolution.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational level to which the exception was escalated, if applicable.

attributes.name: exception_date
attributes.description: The date when the planning exception was identified or when the exception condition is projected to occur.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the planning exception for planner reference.

attributes.name: exception_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique exception number assigned to this planning exception for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: exception_quantity
attributes.description: The magnitude of the exception expressed as a quantity (e.g., shortage quantity, excess quantity, unmet demand quantity).

attributes.name: exception_recurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times this type of exception has occurred for the same SKU-location combination within a defined time window.

attributes.name: exception_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the planning exception indicating the urgency and business impact of the issue.

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planning exception indicating its resolution progress.

attributes.name: exception_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the planning exception was detected and recorded by the IBP system.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planning exception indicating the nature of the supply planning issue. OOS Risk (Out of Stock Risk), Excess Inventory, Late Replenishment, Unmet Demand, Capacity Breach, or Safety Stock Breach.

attributes.name: gap_quantity
attributes.description: The calculated gap between demand and supply that triggered the exception (positive for shortage, negative for excess).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the planning exception record was last modified.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: The planning group or team responsible for managing exceptions for this SKU-location combination.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_date
attributes.description: The specific date within the planning horizon where the exception condition manifests.

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the IBP planning run or DRP execution run that generated this exception.

attributes.name: priority_score
attributes.description: Calculated priority score used to rank exceptions in the planner workbench, based on severity, business impact, and urgency.

attributes.name: projected_inventory_balance
attributes.description: The projected inventory balance at the time of the exception, used to assess the severity of stock-out or excess inventory conditions.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: System-generated or planner-defined recommended action to resolve the planning exception.

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: Source system or process that created this record

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when the planning exception was marked as resolved or closed.

attributes.name: resolution_duration_hours
attributes.description: The elapsed time in hours from exception detection to resolution, used for performance tracking.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the actions taken to resolve the exception and the outcome.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the planning exception was marked as resolved or closed.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause that triggered the planning exception.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the root cause analysis findings for the planning exception.

attributes.name: safety_stock_target
attributes.description: The target safety stock level for the SKU-location combination at the time of the exception.

attributes.name: supply_plan_quantity
attributes.description: The planned supply quantity (production or replenishment) for the affected SKU-location during the exception period.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the exception quantity (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, PAL for pallet).

products.name: sku_planning_param
products.description: Master entity storing SKU-level planning parameters used in demand and supply planning calculations. Captures planning horizon, lot size, minimum order quantity (MOQ), shelf life (days), FEFO/FIFO flag, planning strategy (make-to-stock/make-to-order), ABC/XYZ classification, demand pattern type, seasonality index, and IBP planning group assignment. Distinct from product master (owned by product domain) as this captures supply-planning-specific parameters.

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Planning Parameter ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU planning parameter record. Primary key for this entity.

tag_set.value: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Planning Parameter ID

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility where this SKU is produced or sourced. Used for plant-specific planning parameters.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU in the product master. Links planning parameters to the specific product variant being planned.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: sku_planning_param needs to be associated with the network node it applies to; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC inventory classification based on revenue contribution or consumption value. A items are high-value requiring tight control, C items are low-value with relaxed control.

attributes.name: backorder_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backorders are permitted for this SKU when inventory is insufficient. True allows demand to be backordered, false requires immediate fulfillment or cancellation.

attributes.name: coverage_profile_days
attributes.description: Target days of supply to maintain in inventory. Represents desired inventory coverage horizon based on demand forecast and replenishment frequency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planning parameter record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_part_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as a critical part requiring special planning attention. Critical parts may have higher service levels or expedited replenishment.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Score indicating the quality of the data record

attributes.name: demand_pattern_type
attributes.description: Characterization of the SKUs historical demand pattern. Determines appropriate forecasting method and safety stock calculation approach.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which these planning parameters are no longer active. Null indicates parameters are currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which these planning parameters become active and are used by planning systems. Supports time-phased parameter changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: Fixed production or procurement lot size quantity when using fixed lot size method. Represents standard batch size for manufacturing or ordering.

attributes.name: forecast_model_type
attributes.description: Statistical or machine learning model used for demand forecasting. Determines the algorithm applied during forecast generation in IBP or demand planning systems.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_processing_time_days
attributes.description: Time required for quality inspection and goods receipt processing after physical delivery. Adds to total replenishment lead time.

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used for inventory valuation and consumption. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), or weighted average costing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planning parameter record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for change management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when planning parameters were last reviewed and validated by the planning team. Supports periodic parameter maintenance and accuracy audits.

attributes.name: lot_size_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate production or procurement lot sizes. Determines how order quantities are calculated in MRP and supply planning runs.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Limited by production capacity, storage constraints, or supplier capabilities.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum inventory level target for this SKU. Used in min-max planning to cap inventory investment and prevent overstock situations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Enforced by supplier contracts or manufacturing constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum remaining shelf life required at time of shipment to customer or retail delivery. Ensures product quality and retailer acceptance.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for this SKU. Used for workload assignment and exception management routing.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure that controls how the planning system generates procurement proposals. Determines planning logic and automation level.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next planning parameter review. Ensures regular validation of planning assumptions and parameter accuracy.

attributes.name: order_multiple_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity increment in which orders must be placed. All order quantities must be multiples of this value due to packaging or production constraints.

attributes.name: parameter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special planning considerations, parameter rationale, or exceptions for this SKU. Provides context for planning decisions.

attributes.name: parameter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planning parameter record. Active parameters are used in planning runs, inactive parameters are ignored.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to goods receipt. Used for MRP scheduling and supply plan timing calculations.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: IBP planning group assignment for demand and supply planning segmentation. Groups SKUs with similar planning characteristics for collaborative planning processes.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future for which demand and supply planning is performed. Defines the forward-looking planning window for this SKU.

attributes.name: planning_strategy
attributes.description: Manufacturing planning strategy that determines how the SKU is planned and produced. Make-to-stock produces to forecast, make-to-order produces against customer orders.

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the planning system cannot automatically change planned orders without planner approval. Protects near-term production schedule stability.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is externally procured from suppliers, produced in-house, or both. Determines supply planning logic and sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: Source system or process that created this record

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers a replenishment order. Calculated based on lead time demand plus safety stock to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: rounding_profile_code
attributes.description: Code defining rounding rules for planned order quantities. Ensures quantities align with packaging units, pallet configurations, or production batch constraints.

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate safety stock levels. Fixed quantity uses static buffer, service level based uses demand variability and lead time uncertainty.

attributes.name: seasonality_profile_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the seasonality pattern applied to this SKU for demand forecasting. Links to predefined seasonal index curves (e.g., summer peak, holiday spike).

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: Target service level percentage for this SKU (e.g., 95%, 98%, 99%). Drives safety stock calculation to achieve desired product availability.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the SKU in days from production date to expiration. Critical for FEFO inventory management and demand planning for perishable goods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all planning quantities (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, KG for kilogram). Standardizes quantity representation across planning processes.

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: XYZ demand variability classification. X items have stable demand, Y items have moderate variability, Z items have highly erratic or sporadic demand patterns.

products.name: inventory_projection
products.description: Transactional record capturing the forward-looking inventory projection (projected available balance) for each SKU/location/date combination as output from the supply planning run. Stores projected on-hand, projected on-order, projected demand, projected receipts, days-of-supply projection, OOS risk flag, excess inventory flag, and planning run reference. Distinct from physical inventory positions (owned by inventory domain).

attributes.name: inventory_projection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory projection record. Primary key for this transactional projection entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planner or planning team responsible for this SKU-location combination. Enables accountability and collaboration.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU for which inventory is being projected. Links to the product master data.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location (distribution center, plant, warehouse) for which inventory is projected.

attributes.name: atp_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available to promise to new customer orders on the projection date, calculated from projected balance minus committed allocations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory projection record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: ctp_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity capable to promise considering future production capacity and material availability, extending beyond current ATP.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Projected number of days the available inventory balance will cover forecasted demand. Critical metric for inventory health and service level assessment.

attributes.name: demand_source
attributes.description: Source system or process that provided the demand forecast used in this projection (e.g., statistical forecast, demand sensing, customer orders, consensus demand).

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized exception or alert code triggered by this projection (e.g., LOW_STOCK, EXCESS_INV, CAPACITY_CONSTRAINT). Supports exception-based planning workflows.

attributes.name: excess_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the projected available balance exceeds maximum stock levels or days-of-supply targets, signaling potential overstock risk.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Historical forecast accuracy percentage for this SKU-location combination, used to assess confidence in the projection and adjust safety stock.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory projection record was last updated. Tracks changes and supports version control.

attributes.name: oos_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that the projected available balance falls below safety stock or service level thresholds, signaling potential stockout risk.

attributes.name: planning_bucket
attributes.description: Time granularity of the projection. Daily for near-term tactical planning; weekly or monthly for mid-term; quarterly for long-term strategic planning.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Organizational planning group or segment responsible for this projection (e.g., regional planning team, product category planning team).

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planning run that generated this projection. Enables traceability to planning execution and version control.

attributes.name: planning_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supply planning run that generated this projection was executed. Distinct from record creation; represents the business event time.

attributes.name: projected_available_balance
attributes.description: Net projected inventory balance after accounting for on-hand, receipts, and demand. Key metric for Available-to-Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: projected_demand_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted demand (consumption, sales, or shipments) expected to occur on the projection date. Input from demand planning or demand sensing.

attributes.name: projected_on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted physical inventory quantity expected to be available on-hand at the location on the projection date. Core output of supply planning calculation.

attributes.name: projected_on_order_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted quantity of inventory currently on order (in-transit or planned receipts) expected to arrive by or on the projection date.

attributes.name: projected_receipt_quantity
attributes.description: Forecasted quantity of planned receipts (production output, purchase orders, or replenishment) expected to arrive on the projection date.

attributes.name: projection_confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of confidence in this projection based on demand volatility, forecast accuracy, and supply reliability.

attributes.name: projection_date
attributes.description: The specific future date for which this inventory projection applies. Core dimension for time-series inventory planning.

attributes.name: projection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the planner regarding assumptions, exceptions, or special considerations for this projection.

attributes.name: projection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this projection record. Indicates whether the projection is in draft, approved for execution, published to downstream systems, or superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: projection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the projection methodology. Baseline uses unconstrained demand; constrained applies capacity limits; optimized applies optimization algorithms; scenario and simulation support what-if analysis.

attributes.name: projection_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this projection scenario. Supports multiple what-if scenarios and plan iterations within the same planning cycle.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The reorder point threshold used in the planning logic. When projected balance falls below this level, replenishment is triggered.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The safety stock target quantity used as the baseline for OOS risk assessment on the projection date. May vary by date if dynamic safety stock policies are applied.

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: Target service level (fill rate or in-stock probability) that the projection aims to achieve. Used to calibrate safety stock and OOS risk thresholds.

attributes.name: supply_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assessing supply chain vulnerabilities (supplier reliability, lead time variability, geopolitical risk) that may impact this projection.

attributes.name: supply_source
attributes.description: Source of supply for projected receipts (e.g., internal production, external procurement, transfer from another location).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which all projected quantities are expressed (e.g., EA, CS, KG, LB). Must be consistent across all quantity fields in this record.

products.name: demand_event
products.description: Master entity capturing planned business events that create demand uplift or downlift adjustments to the statistical forecast. Includes trade promotions, new product launches (with ramp-up volume curves, cannibalization impacts, and supply readiness status), product discontinuations, price changes, seasonal events, and market expansion activities. Stores event type, affected SKUs, affected customers/channels, volume impact (units and percentage), event start/end date, confidence level, initial stocking quantity (for launches), launch market/channel scope, and source system reference. Provides the causal layer that explains forecast adjustments beyond statistical extrapolation and bridges R&D/product NPD pipeline with supply chain readiness planning.

attributes.name: demand_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel or sales channel affected by this demand event.

attributes.name: primary_demand_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand planner or business user responsible for creating and maintaining this demand event.

attributes.name: primary_demand_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU affected by this demand event. For multi-SKU events, this may reference a product family or be null with SKU scope defined elsewhere.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: REQUIRED: Demand events (e.g., product launches) are linked to a promotion event for lift analysis and spend tracking.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: demand_event should be linked to the network node where the event impacts supply; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or retail account affected by this demand event. Null for market-wide events.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demand event requires formal approval before being included in the demand plan. True for high-impact or high-risk events.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demand event was approved.

attributes.name: cannibalization_rate_percent
attributes.description: For new product launches, the percentage of new product demand that is expected to cannibalize existing SKU demand rather than represent net-new volume.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level or business certainty that the event will occur and deliver the projected volume impact. Used for risk-adjusted planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demand event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts in this record.

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason
attributes.description: For product discontinuation events, the business rationale for discontinuing the SKU (e.g., low sales, regulatory, reformulation, portfolio rationalization).

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code for the demand event, used for external reference and cross-system tracking.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the demand event, including business rationale, scope, and expected market impact.

attributes.name: event_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the demand event ceases to impact demand. Null for indefinite events such as permanent price changes or discontinuations.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the demand event for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planner comments, assumptions, risks, or additional context about the demand event.

attributes.name: event_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the demand event begins to impact demand. For promotions, this is the promotion start date. For launches, this is the market availability date.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand event. Controls whether the event is included in demand planning calculations.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand event indicating the nature of the business activity that creates demand variance. Determines which event-specific attributes are populated.

attributes.name: initial_stocking_quantity
attributes.description: For new product launches, the initial pipeline fill quantity required to stock distribution centers and retail shelves before consumer demand begins.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this demand event record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: For product discontinuation events, the final date on which orders for the SKU will be accepted.

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: For product discontinuation events, the final date on which the SKU will be shipped to customers.

attributes.name: launch_channel_scope
attributes.description: For new product launches, describes which distribution channels and customer segments are included in the launch (e.g., DTC-only, mass retail, specialty, omnichannel).

attributes.name: market_geography_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code or market region code where the demand event applies. For new product launches, indicates launch market scope.

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the demand planning run or Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle in which this event was incorporated into the forecast.

attributes.name: price_change_amount
attributes.description: For price change events, the absolute change in unit price. Positive for price increases, negative for price decreases.

attributes.name: price_change_percent
attributes.description: For price change events, the percentage change in unit price relative to the previous price.

attributes.name: price_elasticity_coefficient
attributes.description: For price change events, the estimated price elasticity of demand used to calculate volume impact. Negative values indicate normal goods (price up, demand down).

attributes.name: promotion_funding_amount
attributes.description: For trade promotion events, the total budget allocated to fund the promotion, including trade spend, discounts, and allowances.

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: For trade promotion events, the specific promotion mechanism (e.g., temporary price reduction, buy-one-get-one, display allowance, feature ad).

attributes.name: ramp_up_weeks
attributes.description: For new product launches, the number of weeks over which demand is expected to ramp from zero to steady-state volume.

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this demand event in the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supply_readiness_status
attributes.description: For new product launches, indicates whether manufacturing, procurement, and supply chain are ready to support the launch volume. Critical gate for launch approval.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume impact quantities. Aligns with SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: volume_impact_percent
attributes.description: Percentage change in demand relative to the statistical baseline forecast. Positive for uplift, negative for downlift.

attributes.name: volume_impact_units
attributes.description: Absolute incremental or decremental demand volume attributed to this event, expressed in base units. Positive for uplift events, negative for downlift events.

products.name: otif_target
products.description: Master entity defining On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) service level targets by customer, channel, and product category. Captures on-time delivery target (%), in-full fill rate target (%), OTIF composite target (%), measurement window, penalty clause flag, retailer-mandated target flag, and effective date range. Provides the service level commitment baseline for supply planning and distribution execution.

attributes.name: otif_target_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OTIF service level target record.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: otif_target is defined per supply node; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: target_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: OTIF Performance Ownership assigns a responsible employee for each OTIF target in the OTIF Management Dashboard.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer account for which this OTIF target is defined. Null if target applies to a customer segment or channel rather than individual customer.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OTIF target was formally approved and authorized for use in supply planning and performance measurement.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this OTIF target definition, indicating whether it has been reviewed and approved by authorized stakeholders.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who approved this OTIF target definition, typically a supply chain director or customer service leader.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel classification for which this OTIF target is defined (retail, wholesale, direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, foodservice, export).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OTIF target record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_segment_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer segment (e.g., national retailers, regional chains, independent stores) to which this OTIF target applies.

attributes.name: delivery_tolerance_hours
attributes.description: Acceptable time window variance (in hours) before or after the scheduled delivery time within which delivery is still considered on-time.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OTIF target expires or is superseded by a new target definition. Null indicates an open-ended commitment.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this OTIF target becomes effective and is used for performance measurement and compliance evaluation.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Performance threshold below which OTIF failures trigger escalation to senior management or customer service recovery actions.

attributes.name: in_full_fill_rate_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage for in-full order fulfillment, representing the proportion of orders that must be delivered with 100% of requested quantity.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this OTIF target record, used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent review of this OTIF target definition to assess continued relevance and appropriateness.

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which OTIF performance against this target is measured and reported to stakeholders.

attributes.name: measurement_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days over which OTIF performance is measured and evaluated against the target (e.g., rolling 30 days, quarterly 90 days).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this OTIF target to ensure alignment with business strategy and customer expectations.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time delivery performance, representing the proportion of orders that must be delivered within the agreed delivery window.

attributes.name: otif_composite_target_percent
attributes.description: Composite OTIF target percentage representing orders that must meet both on-time AND in-full criteria simultaneously. This is the primary service level commitment metric.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial penalties or chargebacks apply when OTIF performance falls below the target threshold.

attributes.name: penalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to calculate financial penalties when OTIF targets are not met, typically applied to order value or invoice amount.

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: Supply planning team or organizational unit responsible for achieving this OTIF target and managing associated supply plans.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority classification for this OTIF target, indicating the strategic importance and resource allocation priority (tier 1 = highest priority customers).

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Product category or hierarchy level to which this OTIF target applies, enabling category-specific service level commitments.

attributes.name: quantity_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable variance percentage for order quantity fulfillment. Orders within this tolerance are considered in-full (e.g., 98% fulfillment may be acceptable).

attributes.name: retailer_mandated_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OTIF target is mandated by the retailer/customer as part of their vendor compliance program versus internally set by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: sla_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal SLA document or contract section that defines this OTIF commitment.

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the OTIF target definition, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the OTIF target configuration, typically indicating the customer segment or channel it applies to.

attributes.name: target_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, special conditions, or business rationale for this OTIF target definition.

attributes.name: target_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the business owner or supply chain manager accountable for achieving this OTIF target.

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OTIF target definition (active, inactive, pending approval, expired, suspended).

attributes.name: dc_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the distribution center used across operational systems. Externally-known unique code for the facility.

attributes.name: dc_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the distribution center or warehouse facility.

attributes.name: distribution_co_located_manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distribution Co Located Manufacturing Facility Id
attributes.description: FK to manufacturing facility if co-located

tag_set.value: Distribution Co Located Manufacturing Facility Id

attributes.name: distribution_manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: FK to manufacturing facility

attributes.name: dock_doors_inbound
attributes.description: Number of dock doors designated for inbound receiving operations. Impacts receiving throughput capacity and scheduling.

attributes.name: dock_doors_outbound
attributes.description: Number of dock doors designated for outbound shipping operations. Impacts shipping throughput capacity and carrier scheduling.

attributes.name: dsd_hub_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility serves as a DSD hub for direct-to-retail delivery operations. DSD hubs bypass traditional distribution channels for faster store replenishment.

attributes.name: facility_purpose
attributes.description: Purpose classification: distribution, cross-dock, hub

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution center based on temperature control and operational model. Ambient for room temperature, chilled for refrigerated, frozen for sub-zero, multi-temperature for mixed zones, DSD hub for Direct Store Delivery operations, cross-dock for flow-through distribution.

attributes.name: fsc_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified under FSC chain of custody standards for sustainable sourcing. Required for handling FSC-certified paper and wood-based products.

attributes.name: gmp_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified under Good Manufacturing Practice standards. Required for handling cosmetics, personal care, and certain consumer goods products.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified to handle and store hazardous materials. Required for distribution of products with EPA or OSHA regulated substances.

attributes.name: inventory_rotation_method
attributes.description: Primary inventory rotation method used at this facility. FIFO (First In First Out) for standard goods, FEFO (First Expired First Out) for perishables and date-sensitive products, LIFO (Last In First Out) for specific use cases.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the facility lease agreement. Null for owned facilities. Used for lease renewal planning and facility strategy.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center commenced operations. Used for facility age analysis and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekdays in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Used for scheduling inbound deliveries, outbound shipments, and workforce planning.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekends in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Used for scheduling weekend operations and carrier coordination.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the distribution center in its lifecycle. Active indicates full operations, inactive for temporarily closed, under construction for new facilities being built, decommissioned for permanently closed, seasonal for facilities operating only during peak periods, maintenance for temporary closure due to upgrades or repairs.

attributes.name: osa_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target OSA performance percentage for stores served by this distribution center. OSA measures product availability at retail shelf level.

attributes.name: otif_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target OTIF performance percentage for this distribution center. OTIF measures the percentage of orders delivered on time and in full, a key supply chain KPI.

tag_set.value: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of facility ownership model. Owned for company-owned facilities, leased for long-term leased properties, third-party logistics for 3PL-operated warehouses.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the distribution center address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code representing this distribution center in the ERP system. Maps to the SAP MM and WM modules for material management and warehouse management.

attributes.name: sap_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA storage location code within the plant. Represents the primary storage location identifier for inventory transactions in SAP WM module.

attributes.name: shifts_per_day
attributes.description: Number of operational shifts per day at the facility. Used for labor planning, throughput capacity modeling, and operational cost analysis.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division where the facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_pallet_positions
attributes.description: Maximum number of pallet positions available for storage. Key metric for inventory capacity planning and space utilization analysis.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility has temperature-controlled storage zones. True for facilities with chilled or frozen capabilities, false for ambient-only.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the distribution center location. Used for scheduling, shift planning, and cross-facility coordination.

attributes.name: total_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total warehouse floor space capacity in square feet. Includes all storage, staging, and operational areas within the facility.

attributes.name: wms_site_code
attributes.description: Unique site identifier in the Blue Yonder WMS system. Used for integration and synchronization between the lakehouse and the operational WMS platform.

products.name: distribution_storage_location
products.description: Physical storage bin/slot/rack within a distribution facility (WMS-managed). SSOT for physical DC location layout. Distinct from inventory.inventory_storage_location which is the logical inventory holding location.

attributes.name: distribution_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Primary key for storage_location

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent distribution center facility where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Velocity-based classification of the location for slotting optimization: A (high-velocity/fast-moving), B (medium-velocity), C (low-velocity/slow-moving).

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Aisle designation within the warehouse layout for physical navigation and picking route optimization.

attributes.name: bay
attributes.description: Bay or column position within the aisle for precise horizontal location reference.

attributes.name: bin_position
attributes.description: Specific bin or slot position within the level for granular inventory placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: blocked_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location was blocked or made unavailable for operations.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the location is blocked or unavailable, such as maintenance, damage, safety hold, or quality quarantine.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage location record was first created in the WMS system.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for cycle counting inventory at this location to maintain inventory accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: distribution_storage_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within the bay for height-based slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: dsd_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is designated for DSD operations where products bypass the DC and are delivered directly to retail stores.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location became active and available for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: equipment_type_required
attributes.description: Type of material handling equipment required to access this storage location for put-away and picking operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location is scheduled to be decommissioned or removed from active use. Null for indefinite locations.

attributes.name: fefo_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location supports FEFO inventory rotation logic for expiry-sensitive products (pharmaceuticals, food, cosmetics).

tag_set.value: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: fifo_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location supports FIFO inventory rotation logic for age-based stock management.

tag_set.value: First In First Out (FIFO) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is certified and equipped for storing hazardous materials per OSHA and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height dimension of the storage location in centimeters for vertical clearance and equipment reach validation.

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent cycle count was performed at this storage location.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage location record was most recently updated in the WMS system.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the storage location in centimeters for dimensional slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location as defined in Blue Yonder WMS. Typically formatted as aisle-bay-level-bin (e.g., A01-B05-L03-P12).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the storage location for operational reference.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location indicating availability for inventory placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location by operational function: bulk storage, active pick face, reserve inventory, staging area, dock door, or cross-dock zone.

attributes.name: mixed_lot_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple lot or batch numbers for the same SKU or requires lot segregation.

attributes.name: mixed_sku_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple SKUs simultaneously or requires single-SKU dedication.

tag_set.value: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag

attributes.name: pick_face_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as an active pick face for order fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: picking_strategy
attributes.description: Order fulfillment picking method supported by this location: batch picking, wave picking, zone picking, discrete (single-order), or cluster picking.

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: Algorithm used to assign incoming inventory to this location: directed (system-assigned), random, fixed (dedicated SKU), or dynamic (velocity-based).

attributes.name: replenishment_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for automated replenishment from reserve to pick locations, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the storage location to ensure product integrity and regulatory compliance (ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen <-18°C, controlled room temperature).

attributes.name: volume_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Maximum volume capacity of the storage location in cubic meters for space utilization and slotting algorithms.

attributes.name: weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms for safe load management and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width dimension of the storage location in centimeters for dimensional slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Logical zone classification within the distribution center for grouping locations by product category, velocity, or operational workflow (e.g., FAST-PICK, SLOW-MOVE, HAZMAT).

products.name: inbound_receipt
products.description: Transactional record capturing the physical receipt of goods at a DC from suppliers, manufacturing plants, or inter-DC transfers. Records ASN reference, carrier, trailer/container ID, dock door, receipt date/time, received quantity by SKU/lot, temperature check results, and discrepancy flags. Integrates with SAP WM goods receipt and Blue Yonder WMS inbound processing. Drives inventory on-hand updates and FEFO/FIFO lot registration.

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inbound receipt transaction. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier that delivered the shipment to the distribution center.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Receiving operations incur expenses (labor, equipment) that are allocated to a cost center for expense tracking and budgeting.

attributes.name: inbound_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center facility where the goods were received.

attributes.name: inbound_warehouse_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific warehouse or storage facility within the distribution center where goods were received.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Internal transfer receipt: inbound receipts from own plants need the source manufacturing facility to track internal logistics and cost allocation.

attributes.name: primary_inbound_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the quality control personnel who performed the inspection, used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Required for R&D material receipt tracking; links each inbound receipt to the RD project that requested the raw material for formulation trials.

attributes.name: receiving_clerk_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse employee who processed the inbound receipt, used for labor tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor who shipped the goods, representing the counterparty in this receipt transaction.

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of goods accepted into inventory after quality inspection, excluding rejected or damaged items.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical goods arrived and were checked in at the receiving dock, representing the principal business event for this transaction.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Advanced Shipping Notice document sent by the supplier prior to shipment arrival, enabling pre-receipt planning and dock scheduling.

attributes.name: case_count
attributes.description: Number of cases or cartons received in this inbound shipment.

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO standard container identifier for ocean freight shipments, following the BIC (Bureau International des Containers) format.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this receipt record was first created in the system, representing the audit trail start point.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether any discrepancies (quantity, quality, or documentation) were identified during the receiving process.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional details about any discrepancies identified during the receiving process.

attributes.name: discrepancy_reason
attributes.description: Classification of the type of discrepancy identified during receiving, used for root cause analysis and supplier performance management.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Physical dock door location where the inbound shipment was unloaded, used for labor planning and dock utilization tracking.

attributes.name: expected_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of goods expected to be received based on the ASN or purchase order, used for discrepancy detection.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_document_number
attributes.description: SAP Material Management (MM) goods receipt document number generated upon posting the receipt to inventory, linking WMS to ERP.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this receipt record was last updated, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: otif_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this receipt met both on-time delivery and complete quantity requirements, key supplier performance metric.

tag_set.value: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets received in this inbound shipment, used for dock capacity planning and labor allocation.

attributes.name: putaway_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all received goods were moved from the receiving dock to their designated storage locations, completing the inbound process.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether formal quality inspection was required for this receipt based on product category, supplier risk profile, or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the quality inspection process for this receipt, tracking progression through quality control workflow.

attributes.name: receipt_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all receiving activities (unloading, inspection, put-away) were completed and the receipt was closed in the WMS.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the inbound receipt, used for tracking and reference across systems and with suppliers.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inbound receipt transaction, tracking progression from scheduling through completion or exception handling.

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inbound receipt based on the source and nature of the goods being received.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual total quantity of goods physically received and counted during the receiving process.

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of goods rejected during receiving due to quality issues, damage, or non-conformance to specifications.

attributes.name: scheduled_receipt_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the inbound shipment to arrive at the distribution center, based on ASN or supplier commitment.

attributes.name: seal_intact_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the security seal was found intact upon arrival, critical for quality control and loss prevention.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal identifier applied to the trailer or container, verified upon receipt to ensure shipment integrity and prevent tampering.

attributes.name: temperature_check_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether temperature verification was required for this receipt due to cold chain or temperature-sensitive product requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the recorded temperature was within acceptable range per product specifications and cold chain requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_reading_celsius
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading in Celsius recorded during receipt inspection for temperature-sensitive products, critical for cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the trailer or truck that delivered the shipment, used for tracking and carrier performance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the quantities recorded in this receipt (Each, Case, Pallet, Kilogram, Pound, Liter, Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|EA|KG|LB|LT|GL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: inbound_receipt_line
products.description: Line-level detail for each SKU/lot received within an inbound receipt transaction. Captures SKU code, GTIN, lot number, manufacture date, expiry date, received quantity (cases and eaches), unit of measure, pallet ID, temperature at receipt, and variance from expected ASN quantity. Supports FEFO/FIFO lot registration and discrepancy resolution workflows.
products.reference: GR Line Item / WMS Receipt Line

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inbound receipt line. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the warehouse associate who physically received and recorded this line. Used for accountability and performance tracking.

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent inbound receipt header transaction. Links this line to the overall receipt event.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Needed to associate each receipt line (specific SKU/lot) with the RD project using it, enabling traceability of trial material consumption.

attributes.name: regulatory_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Regulatory registration verification during inbound receipt ensures each received SKU is registered in the jurisdiction, a standard compliance step.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Link receipt line to SKU master for traceability and quality inspection; required by receipt processing and compliance audit reports.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who shipped the goods. Used for supplier performance tracking and procurement analytics.

attributes.name: asn_line_number
attributes.description: Line number within the ASN document corresponding to this receipt line. Enables automated matching between ASN and physical receipt.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice document number sent by the supplier prior to shipment arrival. Used for pre-receipt planning and variance detection.

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Quality condition assessment of the received goods. Determines whether product can be put away into available inventory or requires special handling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this receipt line record was first created in the warehouse management system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit cost and extended cost. Supports multi-currency procurement operations.

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any damage, defects, or quality issues observed during receipt inspection. Used for claims and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: expected_quantity_cases
attributes.description: Expected quantity in cases as specified in the Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) or purchase order. Used for variance detection.

attributes.name: expected_quantity_eaches
attributes.description: Expected quantity in eaches as specified in the Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) or purchase order. Used for variance detection.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the product expires and can no longer be sold or used. Critical for FEFO rotation and inventory management in consumer goods.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this receipt line calculated as unit cost multiplied by received quantity. Used for inventory valuation and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the product in the supply chain. May be GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 format.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this receipt line record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking changes to receipt data.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the inbound receipt. Used for ordering and referencing specific lines in the receipt document.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number assigned by the supplier. Critical for traceability, quality control, and recall management in consumer goods.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was manufactured by the supplier. Used for shelf-life calculations and FEFO inventory rotation.

attributes.name: pallet_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pallet or handling unit containing this receipt line. Used for put-away and storage location assignment.

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_number
attributes.description: Line number on the purchase order corresponding to this receipt line. Enables three-way matching between PO, receipt, and invoice.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number authorizing the receipt of these goods. Links the receipt to the original procurement transaction.

attributes.name: put_away_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the goods were put away into their assigned storage location. Used for warehouse productivity and cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt line requires quality inspection before being released to available inventory. True for regulated or high-risk products.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of quality inspection for this receipt line. Determines whether goods can be released to available inventory or must remain in quarantine.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this receipt line within the warehouse workflow. Tracks progression from initial receipt through put-away completion.

attributes.name: received_quantity_cases
attributes.description: Quantity of product received measured in cases. Represents the outer packaging unit typically used for warehouse handling.

attributes.name: received_quantity_eaches
attributes.description: Quantity of product received measured in individual units (eaches). Represents the consumer-facing unit count.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the goods were physically received at the warehouse dock. Critical for OTIF performance measurement and cycle time analytics.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: 18-digit Serial Shipping Container Code identifying the logistics unit. Global standard for tracking pallets and containers in the supply chain.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Warehouse storage location code where the received goods were put away. Identifies the bin, rack, or zone within the distribution center.

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature measurement in Celsius recorded at the time of receipt. Critical for cold chain compliance and product quality verification.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit for the received goods as specified in the purchase order. Used for inventory valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for the received quantity. Defines the counting and handling unit for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code barcode identifier for the received item. Standard 12-digit UPC-A format used in North American retail.

attributes.name: variance_quantity_cases
attributes.description: Difference between expected and received quantity in cases. Positive values indicate overages, negative values indicate shortages.
