attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the invoice against which the deduction was taken. Links to the originating invoice record.

attributes.name: primary_promotion_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or user who approved the deduction settlement. Links to the workforce employee master.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Provides profit‑center level visibility of deduction impact, supporting profit analysis and KPI tracking.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating promotion event that triggered this deduction. Links to the promotion event master.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Deduction entries are charged back to the originating R&D project to track true product cost of promotion.

attributes.name: tertiary_promotion_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this deduction record. Links to the workforce employee master for audit purposes.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retailer or trade account that initiated the deduction. Links to the customer trade account master.

attributes.name: accrual_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this deduction impacts trade promotion accruals. True indicates the deduction should be reconciled against accrued trade spend, false indicates it is outside accrual scope.

attributes.name: aging_days
attributes.description: Number of days the deduction has been open since the deduction date. Used for aging analysis and prioritization of dispute resolution activities.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount deducted by the retailer from the invoice payment. Represents the initial claim amount before dispute resolution.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deduction settlement was approved by the authorized approver. Represents the decision point in the workflow.

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the deduction that was approved and accepted by the manufacturer after dispute resolution. May be less than, equal to, or zero relative to the original deduction amount.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or division code responsible for managing this deduction. Used for organizational reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: claim_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number provided by the retailer for their deduction claim. Used for cross-referencing with retailer systems and documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deduction record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation point.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deduction amount. Indicates the currency in which the deduction was taken.

attributes.name: deduction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the retailer took the deduction from the invoice payment. Represents the business event timestamp for the deduction.

attributes.name: deduction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique deduction number assigned by the retailer or internal system. Used for external communication and dispute tracking.

attributes.name: deduction_source
attributes.description: Source system or channel through which the deduction was received. Retailer portal indicates web-based submission, EDI 846 indicates electronic data interchange, manual entry indicates internal creation, bank reconciliation indicates discovery during payment matching, and automated matching indicates system-generated from remittance data.

attributes.name: deduction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deduction based on the reason for the short-payment. Promotional deductions relate to trade promotions, pricing deductions to price discrepancies, shortage to quantity issues, compliance to retailer policy violations, quality to product defects, freight to shipping issues, and administrative to processing errors. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promotional|pricing|shortage|compliance|quality|freight|administrative — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the manufacturer disputed all or part of the deduction. Provides context for dispute resolution and audit trail.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deduction in the dispute resolution workflow. Open indicates initial receipt, approved indicates full acceptance, disputed indicates challenge by manufacturer, partially_approved indicates partial acceptance, written_off indicates unrecoverable amount, and pending_review indicates under investigation.

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the deduction that is currently under dispute or was rejected by the manufacturer. Represents the portion of the deduction not accepted.

attributes.name: gmroi_impact_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Impact Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage impact of this deduction on the gross margin return on investment for the associated promotion. Used for profitability analysis and promotional effectiveness measurement.

tag_set.value: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Impact Percentage

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deduction record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for dispute resolution based on deduction amount, retailer relationship, and aging. Critical indicates immediate attention required, high indicates urgent resolution needed, medium indicates standard processing, and low indicates routine handling.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Product category or brand code associated with the deduction. Used for category-level trade spend analysis and promotional effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the resolution process, communications with the retailer, and final settlement rationale. Provides audit trail and knowledge base for future similar deductions.

attributes.name: retailer_claim_date
attributes.description: Date on which the retailer filed the deduction claim in their system. May differ from the deduction date.

attributes.name: retailer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the retailer contact person for this deduction. Used for electronic communication during dispute resolution.

attributes.name: retailer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the retailer contact person responsible for this deduction claim. Used for communication and relationship management during dispute resolution.

attributes.name: roi_impact_amount
attributes.description: Calculated impact of this deduction on the promotional return on investment. Represents the reduction in promotional effectiveness due to the deduction. Used for post-event analysis and promotional optimization.

attributes.name: settled_amount
attributes.description: Final monetary amount settled between the manufacturer and retailer after all dispute resolution activities. Represents the actual financial impact of the deduction.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deduction was fully settled and closed. Represents the completion of the deduction lifecycle.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the deduction was settled. Credit memo indicates issuance of a credit note, check indicates physical or electronic check payment, offset_future_invoice indicates deduction from future invoices, write_off indicates unrecoverable amount expensed, and bank_transfer indicates direct electronic payment.

attributes.name: settlement_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the settlement decision. Used for categorization and analysis of settlement patterns.

attributes.name: sla_resolution_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the deduction should be resolved based on internal service level agreements or retailer contractual terms. Used for performance tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: supporting_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting documentation for the deduction claim, such as proof of performance, promotional materials, or retailer correspondence. Used for audit and dispute resolution.

products.name: deduction_settlement
products.description: Transactional record capturing the resolution and settlement of a retailer deduction. Tracks settlement date, settlement method (credit memo, check, offset against future invoice, write-off), settled amount, approved amount, disputed amount, settlement reason code, approver, and linkage to the originating deduction and funding agreement. Enables closed-loop deduction management and accurate trade spend reconciliation.

attributes.name: deduction_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the deduction settlement record. Primary key for the deduction settlement entity.

attributes.name: funding_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion funding agreement or contract that governs the terms under which this deduction was taken and settled.

attributes.name: parent_settlement_deduction_settlement_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent settlement record if this is a follow-up or partial settlement. Enables tracking of multi-stage settlement processes for complex deductions.

attributes.name: primary_deduction_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who approved this deduction settlement. Provides accountability and audit trail for settlement decisions.

attributes.name: promotion_deduction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating retailer deduction that this settlement resolves. Links to the deduction record in the trade promotion management system.

attributes.name: tertiary_deduction_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this settlement record. Provides accountability for changes and supports audit requirements.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer account associated with this deduction settlement. Identifies the retailer or distributor party.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was formally approved by the authorized approver. Marks the transition from under review to approved status.

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The amount approved by the manufacturer for settlement after review and validation. May differ from the claimed amount due to disputes or partial approvals.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for this settlement. Used for organizational reporting and trade spend allocation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for this settlement expense. Used for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis by organizational unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this settlement record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this settlement record. Ensures consistent currency interpretation across multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: deduction_claimed_amount
attributes.description: The original amount claimed by the retailer in the deduction. Represents the initial disputed or taken amount before settlement negotiation.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The approach used to resolve any disputes between the claimed and approved amounts. Documents the resolution process for compliance and process improvement.

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the deduction claimed amount that was disputed or rejected by the manufacturer. Represents the difference between claimed and approved amounts when not fully approved.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which this settlement was recorded. Enables period-based trade spend tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this settlement was recorded. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-over-year trade spend analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this settlement transaction was posted. Ensures proper financial classification and reporting of trade spend.

attributes.name: is_partial_settlement
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this settlement represents a partial resolution of the deduction. True if the deduction requires additional settlements; false if fully resolved.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this settlement record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement payment was issued or credited to the retailer. Represents the actual financial transaction date.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number for the payment transaction, such as check number, wire transfer confirmation, or credit memo number. Used for reconciliation with financial systems.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center associated with this settlement. Enables profitability reporting and analysis by business segment or product line.

attributes.name: settled_amount
attributes.description: The final amount paid or credited to the retailer as part of this settlement. This is the actual financial transaction amount and may include adjustments beyond the approved amount.

attributes.name: settlement_cycle_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days elapsed from deduction claim date to settlement completion. Used for process efficiency measurement and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deduction settlement was finalized and agreed upon by both parties. Represents the business event date for settlement completion.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The mechanism used to resolve and pay the deduction. Indicates how the settlement amount was transferred or credited to the retailer.

attributes.name: settlement_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, negotiation details, or special circumstances related to the settlement. Provides context for future reference and audit.

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the settlement transaction. Used for external communication and audit trails. Format: STL- followed by 8-12 digits.

attributes.name: settlement_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason or category for the settlement. Used for classification and root cause analysis of deductions.

attributes.name: settlement_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of the reason for the settlement, including any specific circumstances, negotiations, or justifications documented during the settlement process.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deduction settlement. Tracks the settlement through approval, payment, and closure workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|rejected|paid|cancelled|under_review|disputed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this settlement was completed within the agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA) timeframe. Used for performance monitoring and retailer relationship management.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system from which this settlement record originated. Supports data lineage and multi-system integration scenarios.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this settlement record in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and troubleshooting.

products.name: promotion_rebate_agreement
products.description: Master entity representing a retailer rebate agreement including its periodic settlement history. Captures agreement terms: retailer account, rebate type (volume tier, growth incentive, category captain, compliance), calculation basis (% of net sales, $ per case), tier thresholds, measurement period, payment frequency, and agreement status. Contains embedded settlement records: settlement period, earned rebate amount, qualifying volume/revenue, tier achieved, payment method, payment date, settlement status (calculated, approved, paid, disputed), and SAP FI payment reference. Distinct from funding agreements in that rebates are earned retrospectively based on performance. Serves as the SSOT for both rebate agreement terms and their periodic settlement calculations.

attributes.name: promotion_rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion rebate agreement. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category covered by this rebate agreement. Null if agreement covers all categories.

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel (e.g., grocery, drug, mass, club, e-commerce) covered by this agreement. Null if agreement covers all channels.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Rebate expenses are allocated to a cost center for budgeting and expense control, a standard finance practice.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Rebate settlements require posting to a GL account; creates a direct link for accurate ledger entries.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand or brand portfolio covered by this rebate agreement. Null if agreement covers all brands.

attributes.name: primary_promotion_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tracks rebate impact on profit centers, enabling profit‑center performance reporting and rebate ROI analysis.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Rebate agreements are tied to new product launches, requiring a link to the originating R&D project.

attributes.name: tertiary_promotion_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this rebate agreement record.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or distributor account that is party to this rebate agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the rebate agreement for easy identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the rebate agreement, used in communications with retailers and in financial systems.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate agreement. Draft is being negotiated, pending approval awaits internal sign-off, active is in force, suspended is temporarily paused, terminated is ended early, and expired has reached its end date.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement was approved by authorized signatories and became binding.

attributes.name: auto_settlement_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether rebate settlements are calculated and processed automatically at the end of each measurement period (true) or require manual review and approval (false).

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the rebate amount. Percent of net sales applies a percentage to net revenue, dollar per case applies a fixed amount per shipping case, dollar per unit applies per individual unit, percent of gross sales applies to pre-discount revenue, and fixed amount is a predetermined lump sum.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_terms
attributes.description: Contractual terms defining the process for resolving disputes over rebate calculations, including escalation procedures and arbitration clauses.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement expires and performance measurement ends. Null for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement becomes active and performance measurement begins.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate agreement record was last updated.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency at which performance is measured for rebate calculation. Monthly measures each calendar month, quarterly each fiscal quarter, semi-annual every six months, annual each fiscal year, and custom uses specific date ranges.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special terms, negotiation history, or operational notes about the rebate agreement.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid rebate balance (total accrued minus total paid). Represents liability owed to the retailer.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: How often rebate payments are made to the retailer. May differ from measurement period (e.g., measured monthly but paid quarterly).

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which rebate payments are remitted. Check is physical check, ACH is Automated Clearing House electronic transfer, wire transfer is same-day bank transfer, credit memo is applied to customer account balance, and offset invoice reduces future invoices.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days after settlement calculation when payment is due to the retailer. Standard terms are 30, 45, or 60 days.

attributes.name: rebate_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate or dollar amount used in rebate calculation. For percentage-based rebates, this is the percentage (e.g., 2.5000 for 2.5%). For dollar-based rebates, this is the dollar amount per unit of measure.

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate agreement based on the performance criteria or strategic objective. Volume tier rewards purchase volume thresholds, growth incentive rewards year-over-year growth, category captain rewards merchandising leadership, compliance bonus rewards adherence to terms, market development funds new market expansion, and promotional support funds joint promotional activities.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter code for the geographic region covered by this agreement (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Null if agreement is not region-specific.

attributes.name: sap_rebate_agreement_number
attributes.description: SAP SD rebate agreement number for financial integration and payment processing. Links to SAP FI/CO for accrual and settlement posting.

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for tier thresholds. Cases refers to shipping cases, units to individual consumer units, dollars to net sales revenue, and physical measures to product weight or volume.

attributes.name: tier_1_rate
attributes.description: Rebate rate applicable when tier 1 threshold is achieved. Format matches calculation_basis (percentage or dollar amount).

attributes.name: tier_1_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying volume or revenue required to earn the first tier rebate rate. Unit of measure defined by threshold_unit field.

attributes.name: tier_2_rate
attributes.description: Rebate rate applicable when tier 2 threshold is achieved. Null if agreement has only one tier.

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying volume or revenue required to earn the second tier rebate rate. Null if agreement has only one tier.

attributes.name: tier_3_rate
attributes.description: Rebate rate applicable when tier 3 threshold is achieved. Null if agreement has fewer than three tiers.

attributes.name: tier_3_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying volume or revenue required to earn the third tier rebate rate. Null if agreement has fewer than three tiers.

attributes.name: tier_structure
attributes.description: Defines how rebate tiers are applied. Single tier has one rate for all qualifying volume, multi-tier has different rates at different thresholds, progressive applies higher rates only to incremental volume above each threshold, and retroactive applies the highest achieved rate to all volume.

attributes.name: total_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate amount accrued across all settlement periods to date. Updated with each settlement calculation.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate amount paid to the retailer across all settlement periods to date. Updated when payments are processed.

attributes.name: tpm_system_code
attributes.description: External system identifier from the source Trade Promotion Management system (e.g., Salesforce TPM, TradeEdge) for integration and reconciliation purposes.

products.name: rebate_settlement
products.description: Transactional record capturing the periodic calculation and payment settlement of retailer rebates under a rebate agreement. Tracks settlement period, earned rebate amount, qualifying volume/revenue, tier achieved, payment method, payment date, settlement status (calculated, approved, paid, disputed), and SAP FI payment reference. Enables accurate rebate liability tracking and cash flow forecasting for the trade finance function.

attributes.name: rebate_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rebate settlement transaction. Primary key for the rebate settlement record.

attributes.name: primary_rebate_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or employee who approved this rebate settlement for payment. Nullable until approval is completed.

attributes.name: promotion_rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent rebate agreement under which this settlement is calculated. Links to the master rebate agreement that defines terms, tiers, and conditions.

attributes.name: tertiary_rebate_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system process that created this rebate settlement record. Audit field for data governance.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade partner receiving the rebate payment. Identifies the counterparty in the rebate settlement transaction.

attributes.name: accrual_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement reverses a previously accrued rebate liability. True if the settlement clears an accrual; False if it represents a new liability.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Manual adjustment applied to the calculated rebate amount. May represent corrections, dispute resolutions, or contractual modifications. Positive or negative value.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate settlement was approved for payment by authorized personnel. Nullable until approval workflow is completed.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate settlement amount was calculated. Represents the business event timestamp when the system computed earned rebate based on qualifying performance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate settlement record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this settlement record. Defines the currency in which rebate is calculated and paid.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trade partner raised a dispute against this settlement. Nullable unless a dispute has been filed.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if the settlement is disputed by the trade partner. Nullable unless settlement_status is 'disputed'.

attributes.name: earned_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Total rebate amount earned by the trade partner for the settlement period. Calculated based on qualifying revenue/volume and applicable rebate rate or tier.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate settlement record was last updated. Audit field for tracking changes and data lineage.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount to be paid to the trade partner after all adjustments. Equals earned_rebate_amount plus adjustment_amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this rebate settlement. May include calculation details, dispute notes, or special instructions.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate payment was issued to the trade partner. Nullable until payment execution is completed.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the rebate payment is issued to the trade partner. Defines the financial instrument used for settlement.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment system or financial institution. Links this settlement to the actual payment transaction in SAP FI or banking system.

attributes.name: qualifying_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue amount that qualifies for rebate calculation during the settlement period. Represents the base upon which rebate percentage or tier is applied.

attributes.name: qualifying_volume
attributes.description: Total volume (units, cases, or other measure) that qualifies for rebate calculation during the settlement period. Used for volume-based rebate agreements.

attributes.name: rebate_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to qualifying revenue or volume to calculate the earned rebate amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.5%).

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed settlement was resolved. Nullable until dispute resolution is completed.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number for the accounting entry related to this rebate settlement. Links to the general ledger posting for rebate expense and liability.

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the rebate settlement. Externally-known unique code used in communications with trade partners and in financial systems. Format: RBS-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance period for which this rebate settlement is calculated. Defines the close of the qualifying transaction window.

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance period for which this rebate settlement is calculated. Defines the beginning of the qualifying transaction window.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate settlement. Tracks progression from initial calculation through approval, payment, and potential dispute resolution.

attributes.name: tier_achieved
attributes.description: Rebate tier level achieved by the trade partner during the settlement period. Identifies which performance threshold was met (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum).

attributes.name: tpm_system_code
attributes.description: External system identifier from the Trade Promotion Management system (e.g., Salesforce TPM, TradeEdge). Links this settlement to the source TPM system record.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the qualifying volume. Defines how volume is quantified for rebate calculation purposes.

products.name: post_event_analysis
products.description: Comprehensive analytical record capturing post-event review (PER) results for a completed promotion event at SKU-retailer-period granularity. Stores baseline volume estimates (methodology, confidence interval, data source, pre-promotion trend), actual promoted volume, incremental lift measurements (units, percentage, lift source — POS scan data, Nielsen IQ panel, TradeEdge secondary sales), measurement methodology, data vintage, planned vs. actual trade spend, promotional ROI, GMROI, cost per incremental case, sell-through rate, OOS incidents, retailer compliance score, and analyst notes. Serves as the single analytical SSOT for all promotion performance measurement including baseline estimation, lift calculation, and ROI analysis. Feeds TPO optimization models, learning loops, and future planning decisions.

attributes.name: post_event_analysis_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the post-event analysis record. Primary key for this analytical entity capturing promotion performance measurement at SKU-retailer-period granularity.

attributes.name: primary_post_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade marketing analyst or data scientist who conducted this post-event analysis. Enables accountability and quality tracking.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the completed promotion event being analyzed. Links to the source promotion execution record in the TPM system.

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade partner where the promotion was executed. Enables retailer-level performance comparison and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: actual_promoted_volume_units
attributes.description: Actual sales volume in units achieved during the promotional period. Core metric for calculating incremental lift and ROI.

attributes.name: actual_trade_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total trade spend actually incurred for this promotion event, including all accruals, deductions, and settlements. Used for actual ROI and GMROI calculation.

attributes.name: analysis_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the post-event analysis was completed and results finalized. Marks the transition to approved or archived status.

attributes.name: analysis_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the promotional period being analyzed. Completes the temporal boundary for performance measurement window.

attributes.name: analysis_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the promotional period being analyzed. Defines the temporal boundary for lift measurement and baseline comparison.

attributes.name: analysis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the post-event analysis. Tracks progression from initial draft through approval and archival.

attributes.name: analyst_notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary from the analyst conducting the post-event review. Captures qualitative insights, contextual factors, and recommendations for future planning.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this post-event analysis was formally approved. Locks the record for reporting and TPO model training.

attributes.name: baseline_confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the statistical confidence interval for baseline estimate. Quantifies uncertainty in baseline calculation.

attributes.name: baseline_confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the statistical confidence interval for baseline estimate. Completes the uncertainty quantification for baseline.

attributes.name: baseline_data_source
attributes.description: Primary data source used for baseline estimation. Identifies whether baseline was derived from POS scan data, syndicated panels, or internal systems.

attributes.name: baseline_estimation_methodology
attributes.description: Statistical or analytical method used to calculate the baseline volume estimate. Critical for understanding confidence and reproducibility of lift measurements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: moving_average|exponential_smoothing|regression|causal_model|nielsen_iq|tradeedge|custom — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: baseline_volume_units
attributes.description: Estimated baseline sales volume in units that would have occurred without the promotion. Foundation for incremental lift calculation.

attributes.name: cost_per_incremental_case
attributes.description: Trade spend divided by incremental lift in case-equivalent units. Measures cost efficiency of generating incremental volume.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this post-event analysis record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Ensures consistent financial reporting across markets.

attributes.name: data_vintage_date
attributes.description: As-of date for the sales data used in this analysis. Important for understanding data latency and potential for future revisions.

attributes.name: display_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer executed the agreed in-store display (end cap, shipper, pallet) as planned. True if compliant, False if not.

attributes.name: feature_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer executed the agreed feature advertising (circular, flyer, digital ad) as planned. True if compliant, False if not.

attributes.name: gmroi
attributes.description: Gross margin return on investment, calculated as incremental gross margin divided by actual trade spend. Measures profitability efficiency of promotional investment.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage lift over baseline, calculated as (incremental lift units / baseline volume units) * 100. Enables comparison across SKUs and events of different scales.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_units
attributes.description: Incremental sales volume in units attributable to the promotion, calculated as actual promoted volume minus baseline volume. Primary measure of promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this post-event analysis record was last updated. Tracks iterative refinement during analysis workflow.

attributes.name: learning_classification
attributes.description: Categorical assessment of promotion performance used to feed TPO learning loops. Enables pattern recognition and future optimization.

attributes.name: lift_measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Analytical approach used to isolate and measure promotional lift. Determines rigor and defensibility of lift claims.

attributes.name: lift_measurement_source
attributes.description: Primary data source used to measure actual promoted volume and calculate lift. Critical for understanding data quality and measurement reliability.

attributes.name: oos_impact_estimated_units
attributes.business_glossary_term: Out of Stock (OOS) Impact Estimated Units
attributes.description: Estimated sales volume lost due to out-of-stock incidents during the promotion. Quantifies the opportunity cost of poor availability.

tag_set.value: Out of Stock (OOS) Impact Estimated Units

attributes.name: oos_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-stock incidents detected during the promotional period. Critical for understanding lost sales opportunity and execution quality.

attributes.name: planned_trade_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total trade spend budgeted for this promotion event at planning time. Baseline for variance analysis and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: pre_promotion_trend
attributes.description: Observed sales trend in the period immediately preceding the promotion. Contextualizes baseline and helps explain lift performance.

attributes.name: pricing_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer maintained the agreed promotional price throughout the event period. True if compliant, False if not.

attributes.name: promotional_roi
attributes.description: Return on investment for this promotion, calculated as (incremental gross profit - actual trade spend) / actual trade spend. Primary financial effectiveness metric.

attributes.name: recommendation_for_future
attributes.description: Strategic recommendation for how this promotion type should be treated in future planning cycles based on performance results.

attributes.name: retailer_compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite score (0-100) measuring retailer adherence to promotional execution requirements including pricing, display, feature, and inventory. Higher scores indicate better execution quality.

attributes.name: sell_through_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of promoted inventory that sold through to consumers during the promotional period. Indicates promotional velocity and inventory efficiency.

attributes.name: trade_spend_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between actual and planned trade spend (actual minus planned). Highlights budget adherence and cost control effectiveness.

products.name: promoted_price
products.description: Master entity capturing the promotional price points defined for SKUs within a promotion event or pricing program. Tracks promoted price type (Hi-Lo temporary price reduction, EDLP, multi-buy, BOGO, scan-back price), promoted price amount, regular shelf price (RSP/MSRP), price reduction depth (%), effective date range, retailer account, channel, and approval status. Distinct from standard list pricing — this entity owns the promotional price layer used during trade events.
products.reference: Promotional Price (SAP SD Condition Records, TPM)

attributes.name: promoted_price_id
attributes.description: Primary key for promoted_price

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution or sales channel (e.g., grocery, mass, club, e-commerce, DTC) where this promotional price is applicable.

attributes.name: primary_promoted_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or manager who approved this promotional price. Used for audit trail and accountability in trade spend governance.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent promotion event or campaign under which this promotional price is defined. Links to the broader trade promotion execution context.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this promotional price is defined. Identifies the specific product variant being promoted.

attributes.name: tertiary_promoted_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this promotional pricing record. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade account for which this promotional price applies. Enables account-specific promotional pricing strategies.

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: The method used to accrue and settle trade promotion funds for this promotional price. Scan-back (per unit sold), bill-back (post-event invoice), off-invoice (upfront discount), lump-sum (fixed payment), or performance-based (tied to metrics).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional price was formally approved for execution. Part of the audit trail for trade promotion compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional price record. Tracks the approval workflow from draft through execution to expiration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|rejected|active|expired|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: The manufacturer's cost of goods sold per unit for the SKU at the time this promotional price was defined. Used for promotional ROI and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this promotional price is valid. Supports multi-country promotional planning and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotional pricing record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the promotional price amount and regular shelf price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional price expires and is no longer valid. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen promotional pricing programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional price becomes active and available for use in retail execution and point-of-sale systems.

attributes.name: estimated_volume_lift
attributes.description: The projected percentage increase in sales volume expected from this promotional price compared to baseline sales. Used for demand planning and promotional forecasting.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Identifies the party responsible for funding this promotional price discount. Manufacturer-funded, retailer-funded, co-op (shared), vendor-funded, or third-party funded.

attributes.name: is_advertised
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this promotional price is featured in retailer advertising, circulars, or marketing campaigns. True if advertised, False if unadvertised in-store promotion.

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this promotional price can be combined (stacked) with other promotions, coupons, or discounts. True if stackable, False if exclusive.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotional pricing record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: maximum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum number of units eligible for this promotional price per transaction or per customer. Used to cap promotional exposure and manage trade spend. Nullable if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum number of units a consumer or retailer must purchase to qualify for this promotional price. Used for multi-buy and volume-based promotions. Nullable if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: price_reduction_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount from the regular shelf price, calculated as ((regular_shelf_price - promotional_price_amount) / regular_shelf_price) * 100. Represents the depth of the promotional discount.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional pricing strategy. Hi-Lo (High-Low temporary price reduction), EDLP (Everyday Low Price), multi-buy (e.g., 2 for $5), BOGO (Buy One Get One), scan-back (retailer scans at checkout for discount), temporary price reduction, rebate, or coupon-based pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hi_lo|edlp|multi_buy|bogo|scan_back|temporary_price_reduction|rebate|coupon — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promotional_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The per-unit allowance or funding provided by the manufacturer to the retailer to support this promotional price. Used for trade spend accrual and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: promotional_price_amount
attributes.description: The promoted price point for the SKU during the promotional period. This is the actual selling price offered to consumers or retailers during the promotion.

attributes.name: promotional_price_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code for this promotional price record. Used for external reference and integration with TPM systems.

attributes.name: promotional_price_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the promotional price offer, including terms, conditions, and any special instructions for retail execution or consumer communication.

attributes.name: promotional_price_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this promotional price configuration, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code where this promotional price is applicable. Enables regional pricing strategies and localized trade promotions.

attributes.name: regular_shelf_price
attributes.description: The standard or recommended selling price (RSP/MSRP) for the SKU before the promotional discount is applied. Used as the baseline for calculating price reduction depth.

attributes.name: retailer_margin_percentage
attributes.description: The target or agreed-upon margin percentage for the retailer when selling at this promotional price. Used for trade negotiation and pricing strategy analysis.

attributes.name: scan_back_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit reimbursement rate paid to the retailer for each unit sold at the promotional price under a scan-back pricing model. Nullable if not a scan-back promotion.

attributes.name: tpm_system_code
attributes.description: External system identifier from the source Trade Promotion Management system (e.g., Salesforce TPM, SAP TPM). Used for data lineage and system integration.

products.name: lift_measurement
products.description: Transactional record capturing incremental volume lift measurements for a promotion event at the SKU-retailer-week level. Stores baseline volume (pre-promotion trend), actual promoted volume, incremental lift units, incremental lift percentage, lift source (POS scan data, Nielsen IQ panel, TradeEdge secondary sales), measurement methodology, confidence interval, and data vintage. Feeds TPO optimization models and post-event ROI calculations.

attributes.name: lift_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional lift measurement record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who performed or validated the lift measurement analysis.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific retail store location where lift was measured, if applicable.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU for which promotional lift is measured.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade account where the promotion was executed.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion event for which lift is being measured.

attributes.name: actual_promoted_volume_units
attributes.description: The actual volume in units sold during the promotional period.

attributes.name: baseline_calculation_method
attributes.description: The specific method used to calculate the baseline volume for comparison.

attributes.name: baseline_period_weeks
attributes.description: The number of weeks of historical data used to establish the baseline trend.

attributes.name: baseline_volume_units
attributes.description: The expected volume in units based on pre-promotion trend analysis, representing what would have sold without the promotion.

attributes.name: cannibalization_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of incremental lift that came from other SKUs within the same brand or category, indicating internal sales transfer.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: The lower bound of the confidence interval for the lift measurement, typically at 95% confidence level.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: The upper bound of the confidence interval for the lift measurement, typically at 95% confidence level.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percentage
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level of the lift measurement, typically 90%, 95%, or 99%.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lift measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record.

attributes.name: data_vintage_date
attributes.description: The date when the source data used for this lift measurement was extracted or made available.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount offered during the promotion, calculated as ((regular price - promotional price) / regular price) * 100.

attributes.name: halo_effect_units
attributes.description: The additional volume lift observed in related non-promoted SKUs due to the promotion, representing positive spillover effects.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage lift over baseline, calculated as (incremental lift units / baseline volume units) * 100.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_units
attributes.description: The incremental volume in units attributable to the promotion, calculated as actual promoted volume minus baseline volume.

attributes.name: incremental_revenue
attributes.description: The incremental revenue generated by the promotion, calculated as incremental lift units multiplied by promotional price.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lift measurement record was last updated.

attributes.name: lift_source
attributes.description: The data source used to measure promotional lift.

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: The statistical methodology used to calculate baseline and incremental lift.

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any anomalies, data quality issues, or special considerations for this lift measurement.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: The current status of the lift measurement in the validation and approval workflow.

attributes.name: measurement_week_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the week for which lift is measured.

attributes.name: measurement_week_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the week for which lift is measured, typically aligned with retailer calendar weeks.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: The p-value from the statistical test of lift significance, where values below 0.05 typically indicate statistical significance.

attributes.name: post_promotion_dip_units
attributes.description: The volume decline observed in the weeks immediately following the promotion, indicating pantry loading or forward buying effects.

attributes.name: promotional_price
attributes.description: The actual selling price during the promotional period.

attributes.name: regular_price
attributes.description: The regular non-promotional selling price used as baseline for price comparison.

attributes.name: statistical_significance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured lift is statistically significant at the specified confidence level.

attributes.name: tpm_system_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trade Promotion Management (TPM) System Reference ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this lift measurement record in the source TPM system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).

tag_set.value: Trade Promotion Management (TPM) System Reference ID

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the lift measurement was validated and approved for use in ROI calculations.

products.name: tpo_scenario
products.description: Master entity representing a Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) scenario — a modeled alternative promotion plan generated to optimize trade spend ROI. Captures scenario name, optimization objective (maximize volume, maximize ROI, maximize GMROI, minimize OOS), scenario status (draft, evaluated, approved, rejected), total scenario spend, projected incremental volume, projected ROI, comparison baseline scenario reference, and analyst owner. Enables what-if planning and scenario comparison for trade investment decisions.

attributes.name: tpo_scenario_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the TPO scenario. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category this TPO scenario focuses on, if scenario is category-specific.

attributes.name: channel_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel this TPO scenario applies to, if scenario is channel-specific.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary brand this TPO scenario focuses on, if scenario is brand-specific.

attributes.name: parent_scenario_tpo_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent TPO scenario if this scenario is a variant or iteration derived from another scenario.

attributes.name: primary_tpo_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade marketing analyst or manager who owns and is responsible for this TPO scenario.

attributes.name: tertiary_tpo_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this TPO scenario for execution or further analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the baseline or control TPO scenario against which this scenario is compared for incremental analysis.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific retail account this TPO scenario targets, if scenario is account-specific.

attributes.name: trade_calendar_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional calendar that defines the planning period and promotional events covered by this scenario.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the TPO scenario was formally approved for execution or implementation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country this scenario applies to.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TPO scenario record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this scenario.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the TPO scenario was evaluated and optimization calculations were completed.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage level of the TPO scenario: national, regional, local, or global.

attributes.name: is_baseline_scenario
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this scenario serves as the baseline control scenario for comparison purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TPO scenario record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, assumptions, constraints, or context relevant to this TPO scenario.

attributes.name: optimization_objective
attributes.description: Primary business goal the TPO scenario is designed to achieve: maximize volume, maximize ROI, maximize GMROI, minimize out-of-stock events, maximize profit, or balanced growth.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the planning period covered by this TPO scenario.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the planning period covered by this TPO scenario.

attributes.name: projected_baseline_revenue
attributes.description: Forecasted gross revenue expected without promotional activity, serving as the baseline for incremental revenue calculation.

attributes.name: projected_baseline_volume
attributes.description: Forecasted sales volume in units expected without any promotional activity, serving as the baseline for lift calculation.

attributes.name: projected_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: Expected gross margin return on investment, calculated as gross margin dollars generated per dollar of trade spend invested.

tag_set.value: Projected Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)

attributes.name: projected_gross_profit
attributes.description: Forecasted gross profit (revenue minus COGS) expected from this TPO scenario after accounting for trade spend.

attributes.name: projected_incremental_revenue
attributes.description: Additional gross revenue expected to be generated by the promotional activities in this scenario, above the baseline.

attributes.name: projected_incremental_volume
attributes.description: Additional sales volume in units expected to be generated by the promotional activities defined in this TPO scenario, above the baseline.

attributes.name: projected_promotional_lift_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage increase in sales volume compared to baseline, calculated as (incremental volume / baseline volume) * 100.

attributes.name: projected_roi_percentage
attributes.description: Expected return on investment expressed as a percentage, calculated as (incremental profit / total scenario spend) * 100.

attributes.name: projected_total_revenue
attributes.description: Total forecasted gross revenue including both baseline and incremental revenue for this scenario.

attributes.name: projected_total_volume
attributes.description: Total forecasted sales volume in units including both baseline and incremental volume for this scenario.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal region code identifying the sales or geographic region this scenario covers.

attributes.name: scenario_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the purpose, assumptions, and strategic intent of the TPO scenario.

attributes.name: scenario_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name assigned to the TPO scenario for easy identification and reference by trade marketing teams.

attributes.name: scenario_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the TPO scenario, typically system-generated with a TPO prefix.

attributes.name: scenario_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the TPO scenario indicating its readiness for execution or decision-making.

attributes.name: total_scenario_spend
attributes.description: Total trade promotion investment allocated across all promotions and accounts in this TPO scenario.

attributes.name: tpm_system_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trade Promotion Management (TPM) System Reference ID
attributes.description: External identifier linking this TPO scenario to the source Trade Promotion Management system (e.g., Salesforce TPM, SAP TPM).

tag_set.value: Trade Promotion Management (TPM) System Reference ID

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking iterations and revisions of this TPO scenario.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all volume metrics in this scenario (units, cases, pallets, kg, liters).

products.name: retailer_compliance
products.description: Transactional record capturing retailer execution compliance for a promotion event — whether the retailer delivered the agreed promotional mechanics (feature ad, display, price point, shelf placement per POG). Tracks compliance check date, compliance type (ad feature, display, price compliance, OSA), compliance score (%), non-compliance reason, penalty amount applied, auditor/field rep reference, and data source (SFA field audit, third-party compliance service). Feeds deduction dispute resolution and future funding negotiations.
products.reference: Retail Execution Compliance (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud SFA)

attributes.name: retailer_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retailer compliance record. Primary key for this transactional compliance audit entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field sales representative or auditor who performed the compliance check. Enables accountability and audit trail for compliance assessments.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific retail store location where compliance was audited. Enables store-level compliance tracking and analysis.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade account whose compliance is being measured. Identifies the party responsible for executing the promotional mechanics.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion event being audited for compliance. Links this compliance record to the parent promotional campaign.

attributes.name: actual_retail_price
attributes.description: The actual price observed at the retail location during the compliance audit. Compared against agreed promotional price to determine price compliance.

attributes.name: ad_feature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer included the promoted product in their feature advertisement or circular as agreed. True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: agreed_promotional_price
attributes.description: The promotional price point that was contractually agreed between the manufacturer and retailer. Used as the benchmark for price compliance verification.

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify compliance. Field rep visit = in-person store check by manufacturer sales team, third-party audit = independent compliance service, POS data analysis = automated analysis of retailer sales data, photo verification = photographic evidence submitted digitally, retailer self-report = retailer-provided compliance attestation.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: The name of the field representative or third-party auditor who conducted the compliance check. Provides human-readable reference for audit accountability.

attributes.name: compliance_check_date
attributes.description: The date when the compliance audit or field check was performed. Represents the business event timestamp for this compliance observation.

attributes.name: compliance_score_percentage
attributes.description: The overall compliance score expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Represents the degree to which the retailer met the agreed promotional execution terms. Used for funding adjustments and future negotiation leverage.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: The overall compliance determination for this audit record. Compliant = all mechanics met, non-compliant = one or more mechanics failed, partial compliant = some mechanics met, pending review = audit submitted but not yet adjudicated, disputed = retailer has challenged the compliance finding.

attributes.name: compliance_type
attributes.description: The category of promotional mechanic being audited. Ad feature = retailer circular/flyer inclusion, display = in-store promotional display presence, price compliance = agreed promotional price point adherence, OSA = On Shelf Availability during promotion, POG placement = planogram compliance, multi-mechanic = combined audit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this compliance record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The system or channel from which this compliance record originated. SFA field audit = Salesforce mobile app, third-party service = external compliance vendor, POS integration = retailer point-of-sale data feed, retailer portal = retailer self-service submission, manual entry = back-office data entry.

attributes.name: data_source_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier from the originating system (e.g., SFA visit ID, third-party audit ticket number, POS transaction batch ID). Enables traceability back to source system for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: display_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer set up the agreed in-store promotional display (end cap, floor stand, shipper display). True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer has formally disputed this compliance assessment. True = dispute filed, False = no dispute. Disputed records feed deduction dispute resolution workflows.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the retailer for why they are disputing the compliance finding. Captures retailer perspective and supporting evidence for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: funding_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net adjustment to trade spend funding based on compliance performance. Positive values indicate additional funding earned through over-compliance; negative values indicate funding clawback due to non-compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance record was last updated. Tracks changes due to dispute resolution, data corrections, or status updates.

attributes.name: non_compliance_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the non-compliance root cause. Enables aggregated analysis of compliance failure patterns across retailers and promotions.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the retailer failed to meet compliance requirements. Captures root cause details such as inventory shortage, operational error, pricing system failure, or deliberate non-execution.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text observations or context from the auditor. May include qualitative details about store conditions, retailer cooperation, or extenuating circumstances affecting compliance.

attributes.name: osa_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promoted product was in stock and available on shelf during the promotional period. True = compliant (in stock), False = non-compliant (out of stock).

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The financial penalty or funding adjustment applied due to non-compliance. May be deducted from retailer rebate or future funding allocations. Null if fully compliant.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to photographic evidence captured during the compliance audit. Supports visual verification of display presence, pricing signage, shelf placement, and ad feature inclusion.

attributes.name: pog_placement_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product was placed according to the agreed planogram specifications (shelf position, facings, adjacency). True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: price_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer honored the agreed promotional price point (Hi-Lo or EDLP pricing strategy). True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: resolution_date

products.name: flight_allocation
products.description: This association captures the allocation of a promotion_event to a campaign_flight, including spend and volume metrics that are specific to the event‑flight pairing. Each record links one promotion_event to one campaign_flight and stores attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: A promotion_event represents a specific trade promotion execution at a retailer/store, while a campaign_flight represents a media flight for a marketing campaign. In practice, a single promotion_event can be linked to multiple campaign_flights (e.g., the same in‑store promotion is supported by TV, digital, and print flights), and a single campaign_flight can include many promotion_events across different retailers. The business tracks allocation of spend and volume per promotion_event‑flight pair, which is managed by planners as a distinct record.
