attributes.description: Brand's share of total advertising and promotional activity within the category, measured across paid media, earned media, and owned channels. Key indicator of marketing investment relative to competitors.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Specific subcategory within the broader brand category. Provides granular classification for competitive analysis and shelf placement strategy.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Third-party sustainability certifications or eco-labels associated with the brand, such as FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), or B Corp. Multiple certifications separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment
attributes.description: Primary demographic and psychographic profile of the intended consumer audience for the brand. Includes age range, income level, lifestyle attributes, and purchase behaviors.

attributes.name: target_som_percent
attributes.description: Strategic target for the brand's market share. Used for annual planning, performance evaluation, and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: target_sov_percent
attributes.description: Strategic target for the brand's share of voice in the category. Used for media planning and budget allocation decisions. Typically set to exceed current SOM (Share of Market) to drive growth.

attributes.name: trademark_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current trademark registration expires and requires renewal. Critical for maintaining legal protection of brand assets.

attributes.name: trademark_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic territories or countries where the brand trademark is registered and legally protected. May include multiple jurisdictions separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: trademark_registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the trademark was officially registered with the relevant trademark authority. Used for renewal tracking and IP portfolio management.

attributes.name: trademark_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number assigned by the trademark authority for the brand name, logo, or other protected brand elements. Used for legal protection and IP (Intellectual Property) management.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial value of the brand as an intangible asset. Calculated using income, market, or cost approaches for financial reporting and M&A (Mergers and Acquisitions) purposes.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master record for each marketing campaign executed by Consumer Goods. Captures campaign name, type (ATL, BTL, digital, shopper, influencer, integrated), objective, target audience, brand association, channel mix, planned vs. actual media spend, campaign start/end dates, creative concept, campaign status, and owning brand/category. Sourced from Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and internal campaign management systems.
products.reference: Campaign Management / Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing campaign. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who approved this campaign for execution. Links to workforce/user master data.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category this campaign targets. Links to the category hierarchy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Campaign expense allocation requires charging campaign spend to a specific cost center for budgeting.

attributes.name: esg_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_commitment. Business justification: Campaigns are often created to support specific ESG commitments; linking enables compliance tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Campaign costs are posted to a specific GL account to support detailed expense reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary brand being promoted in this campaign. Links to the brand master data.

attributes.name: primary_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Campaign planning and ROI attribution need a primary SKU reference to allocate budget and measure lift per product.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Campaign planning aligns with R&D product development projects to synchronize launch timing and messaging.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Campaigns are owned by a sales rep responsible for execution and alignment with sales activities.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Campaign Sponsorship Procurement: marketing campaigns often have a sponsoring supplier; linking enables sponsor spend tracking and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predefined consumer segment this campaign is designed to reach. Links to consumer segmentation master data.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.trade_account. Business justification: Campaigns are often targeted to specific key trade accounts; the marketing team needs to link each campaign to the account for promotion planning and performance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign concluded. May differ from planned end date due to extensions, early termination, or performance-based adjustments.

attributes.name: actual_media_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual total media spend incurred for this campaign, in the company's reporting currency. Includes all paid media costs across channels.

attributes.name: actual_production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The actual cost incurred for creative production, including all content creation, design, video production, and asset development expenses.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign went live and began execution. May differ from planned start date due to operational adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign was formally approved for execution by authorized stakeholders, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the campaign: draft (initial planning), planned (scheduled), approved (ready for execution), active (currently running), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (finished), or cancelled (terminated before completion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|planned|approved|active|paused|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign by execution approach: ATL (Above The Line - mass media), BTL (Below The Line - targeted), digital (online channels), shopper (in-store/retail), influencer (social media partnerships), or integrated (multi-channel).

attributes.name: channel_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of marketing channels used in the campaign (e.g., TV, digital display, social media, print, radio, OOH, in-store).

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify and track the campaign across systems, media buys, and analytics platforms.

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the campaign is executed (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: creative_concept
attributes.description: High-level description of the creative theme, messaging strategy, and visual identity used in the campaign.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this campaign record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the campaign's purpose, strategy, key messages, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the campaign: global (worldwide), regional (multi-country region), national (single country), or local (city/metro area).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the campaign is currently active (True) or inactive (False). Active campaigns are either running or scheduled to run.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign record was last updated or modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the marketing campaign as used in internal planning and external communications.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary business goal of the campaign: awareness (brand visibility), consideration (product evaluation), conversion (purchase), loyalty (retention), launch (new product introduction), or relaunch (product refresh).

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for campaign conclusion as defined during planning phase.

attributes.name: planned_media_spend_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted total media spend allocated to this campaign during the planning phase, in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: planned_production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted cost for creative production, including content creation, design, video production, and asset development.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for campaign launch as defined during planning phase.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this campaign in the source operational system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Textual description of the intended consumer segment for this campaign, including demographic, psychographic, and behavioral characteristics.

products.name: campaign_flight
products.description: Transactional record of campaign execution at the flight level, capturing performance metrics across ALL channels (digital, TV, OOH, print, social, search, programmatic) at the campaign-channel-market-date grain. Defines scheduled media run dates, channel, market/geography, budget allocation, and flight-level performance targets. Captures planned and actual impressions, clicks, CTR, video views, view-through rate, conversions, CPC, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency, GRPs (traditional), and platform-specific metrics (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic DSP). A single campaign may have multiple flights across different channels or geographies. Sourced from digital ad platform APIs, agency post-buy reports, and media monitoring systems. Serves as the unified granular performance record for omnichannel campaign measurement.

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campaign flight record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign. A single campaign may have multiple flights across different channels or geographies.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the creative asset used in this flight. Links to creative asset management system for creative performance analysis.

attributes.name: flight_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Flight manager (employee) oversees execution; essential for flight performance review and responsibility logs.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand being promoted in this flight. Enables brand-level campaign performance aggregation.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.retail_store. Business justification: Flight schedules are executed at individual retail stores; linking flight to store enables store‑level media execution tracking and OTIF reporting.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the flight media execution ended. Captures real execution timeline for post-campaign analysis.

attributes.name: actual_impressions
attributes.description: Actual number of impressions delivered during the flight. Core metric for reach and frequency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the flight media execution began. Used for variance analysis against planned schedule.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: Attribution methodology used to assign conversion credit to this flight. Critical for multi-touch attribution analysis.

attributes.name: budget_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated to this flight. Represents the planned media spend for this specific flight execution.

attributes.name: budget_spent_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount spent on this flight. Used for budget variance analysis and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) calculation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary media channel for this flight execution. Supports omnichannel campaign measurement across digital, TV, out-of-home, print, social media, and search.

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Total number of clicks generated by the flight. Primary engagement metric for digital and search campaigns.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate expressed as a decimal (conversions divided by clicks or impressions). Measures campaign effectiveness in driving desired actions.

attributes.name: conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions attributed to this flight. Conversion definition varies by campaign objective (purchase, sign-up, download, etc.).

attributes.name: cpa
attributes.description: Average cost per conversion for this flight. Critical metric for performance marketing and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: cpc
attributes.description: Average cost per click for this flight. Key efficiency metric for paid search and digital campaigns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: ctr
attributes.description: Click-through rate expressed as a decimal (clicks divided by impressions). Key performance indicator for digital campaign effectiveness.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this flight record.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or platform from which performance data was captured (e.g., Meta API, Google Ads API, agency post-buy report, Nielsen IQ). Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: flight_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the campaign flight for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the flight within the campaign. Used for external reporting and agency coordination.

attributes.name: flight_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the campaign flight.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times an individual was exposed to the campaign (impressions divided by reach). Measures message repetition.

attributes.name: grp
attributes.description: Gross Rating Points for traditional media (TV, radio, OOH). Measures total audience delivery as a percentage of target population multiplied by frequency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: market_geography
attributes.description: Geographic market or region where the flight is executed. Supports market-level performance tracking and regional campaign optimization.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date on which performance metrics were measured or reported. Supports daily granular performance tracking at the campaign-channel-market-date grain.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the flight execution, performance anomalies, or special circumstances. Supports qualitative context for quantitative performance data.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Specific placement or ad format type within the channel (e.g., banner, video, native, sponsored post, display, search text ad). Enables placement-level optimization.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Specific advertising platform or network (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, programmatic DSP, linear TV network). Enables platform-specific performance analysis.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Product category or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) group being promoted. Supports category-level marketing effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique individuals exposed to the campaign flight. Used for audience coverage analysis.

attributes.name: roas
attributes.description: Return on Ad Spend expressed as a ratio (revenue generated divided by ad spend). Primary metric for campaign profitability assessment.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned end date for the flight media run. Defines the flight duration for budget allocation and performance measurement.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the flight media run. Used for campaign planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the target audience segment for this flight (e.g., demographic, psychographic, behavioral criteria). Supports audience-specific performance analysis.

attributes.name: target_impressions
attributes.description: Planned number of impressions for this flight. Used for media planning and performance target setting.

attributes.name: video_completion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that were completed (watched to end). Measures creative engagement quality.

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: Total number of video views for video creative flights. Applicable to digital video, social, and TV campaigns.

products.name: media_plan
products.description: Formal media plan document capturing planned media investments across channels (TV, digital, OOH, print, social, search, programmatic) for a brand or campaign. Includes planned impressions, GRPs, reach, frequency, CPM, total planned spend, agency, media owner, market, and planning period. Serves as the authoritative pre-buy record for media investment decisions.

attributes.name: media_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media plan record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign associated with this media plan.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand for which this media plan is created.

attributes.name: planner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Media planner employee owns the plan; needed for budget approval audit and planner workload tracking.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Media plans are built for product launches that stem from a particular R&D project, ensuring budget aligns with development timeline.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this media plan.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this media plan was formally approved for execution.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of total campaign or brand budget allocated to this media plan line.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this media plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: creative_format
attributes.description: Format of the creative asset planned for this media (e.g., 30-second spot, banner ad, full-page print, billboard).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the planned spend amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time segment of day for broadcast media (e.g., Prime Time, Early Morning, Late Night, Daytime).

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the media flight or execution period for this plan.

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the media flight or execution period for this plan.

attributes.name: kpi_target
attributes.description: Target Key Performance Indicator metric and value for measuring media plan success (e.g., Reach 70%, CTR 2.5%, ROAS 3.0).

attributes.name: market
attributes.description: Geographic market or Designated Market Area (DMA) targeted by this media plan (e.g., USA, New York DMA, UK).

attributes.name: media_channel
attributes.description: Primary media channel category for this plan line (TV, digital, out-of-home, print, social, search, programmatic, radio, cinema, podcast). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tv|digital|ooh|print|social|search|programmatic|radio|cinema|podcast — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: media_owner
attributes.description: Name of the media owner or publisher (e.g., NBC, Google, Meta, Clear Channel).

attributes.name: media_subchannel
attributes.description: Detailed subchannel or platform within the primary media channel (e.g., Facebook, Google Display, National TV, Local Radio).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this media plan record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes, comments, or special instructions related to this media plan.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary marketing objective for this media plan (awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, trial).

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the media plan used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or title of the media plan document.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the media plan indicating its approval and execution state.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the media plan by planning horizon and purpose.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version number of this media plan document to track revisions and iterations.

attributes.name: planned_cpm
attributes.description: Planned cost per thousand impressions for this media investment.

attributes.name: planned_cpp
attributes.description: Planned cost per rating point for broadcast media investments.

attributes.name: planned_frequency
attributes.description: Planned average number of times the target audience will be exposed to the media message.

attributes.name: planned_grp
attributes.description: Planned Gross Rating Points representing the total reach multiplied by frequency for the target audience.

attributes.name: planned_impressions
attributes.description: Total number of planned impressions (ad exposures) for this media plan.

attributes.name: planned_reach_percent
attributes.description: Planned percentage of the target audience reached at least once during the planning period.

attributes.name: planned_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total planned media spend amount for this media plan in the base currency.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this media plan.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this media plan.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the target audience demographic or segment for this media plan (e.g., Adults 25-54, Moms with Kids, HHI 75K+).

products.name: media_spend
products.description: Transactional record of actual media spend incurred per channel, campaign, brand, and time period. Captures invoiced spend, committed spend, variance to plan, media owner, agency fees, working vs. non-working spend classification, and cost-per-metric actuals (CPM, CPC, CPV). Sourced from agency billing systems and reconciled against media plan commitments.

attributes.name: media_spend_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media spend transaction record. Primary key for the media spend data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign associated with this media spend transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Media spend invoices are posted against cost centers to track advertising costs per organizational unit.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system that performed the reconciliation of this media spend record.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accounting of media spend requires a GL account reference for journal entry creation.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand for which this media spend was incurred.

attributes.name: media_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media plan that authorized this spend.

attributes.name: agency_fee_amount
attributes.description: The agency service fee or commission charged for managing the media buy.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: The name of the media agency that managed the media buy and invoiced the spend.

attributes.name: buy_type
attributes.description: The method by which the media inventory was purchased (e.g., Programmatic, Direct, Auction, Guaranteed).

attributes.name: clicks_delivered
attributes.description: The total number of clicks generated by the media placement for this spend transaction.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the media spend was incurred (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: cpc_actual
attributes.description: The actual cost per click (CPC) achieved for this media spend, calculated as working spend divided by clicks delivered.

attributes.name: cpm_actual
attributes.description: The actual cost per thousand impressions (CPM) achieved for this media spend, calculated as (working spend / impressions) * 1000.

attributes.name: cpv_actual
attributes.description: The actual cost per video view (CPV) achieved for this media spend, calculated as working spend divided by video views delivered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media spend record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the spend amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope of the media placement (e.g., National, Regional, Local, Global).

attributes.name: impressions_delivered
attributes.description: The total number of ad impressions delivered for this spend transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number from the media owner or agency billing system for this spend transaction.

attributes.name: invoiced_spend_amount
attributes.description: The total amount invoiced by the media owner or agency for this media spend transaction.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this media spend record is currently active and valid (True) or has been voided or superseded (False).

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific market or Designated Market Area (DMA) where the media was placed (e.g., New York, Los Angeles, London).

attributes.name: media_channel
attributes.description: The media channel through which the advertising was delivered (e.g., TV, Digital Display, Social Media, Search). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TV|Radio|Print|Digital Display|Social Media|Search|Video|Out-of-Home|Programmatic|Influencer|Podcast|Streaming|Email|Mobile|Affiliate|Sponsorship|Other — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: media_owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the media owner or publisher that provided the advertising inventory (e.g., Google, Meta, NBC Universal).

attributes.name: media_subchannel
attributes.description: The specific subchannel or platform within the media channel (e.g., Facebook, Google Ads, CNN, Spotify).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media spend record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: non_working_spend_amount
attributes.description: The portion of invoiced spend allocated to agency fees, production costs, and other non-media expenses (non-working media).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this media spend transaction, including reconciliation notes or dispute details.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice for this media spend was paid.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The payment status of the invoice associated with this media spend transaction.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of media placement or ad format (e.g., Banner, Video Pre-Roll, Native, Sponsored Post, 30-Second Spot).

attributes.name: planned_spend_amount
attributes.description: The originally planned or committed spend amount from the media plan for this channel and period.

attributes.name: production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The cost of creative production, ad serving, and other production-related expenses included in this spend transaction.

attributes.name: reconciled_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media spend record was reconciled against the media plan and delivery metrics.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current reconciliation status of this spend transaction against the media plan and delivery metrics.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this media spend record in the source system.

attributes.name: spend_date
attributes.description: The date on which the media spend was incurred or invoiced.

attributes.name: spend_period
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar period (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03) to which this spend is allocated for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: The demographic or psychographic target audience for this media placement (e.g., Adults 25-54, Moms with Kids, High-Income Households).

attributes.name: variance_to_plan_amount
attributes.description: The difference between invoiced spend and planned spend (invoiced minus planned), indicating over- or under-spend.

attributes.name: video_views_delivered

attributes.name: working_spend_amount
attributes.description: The portion of invoiced spend that directly purchased media inventory (working media), excluding agency fees and production costs.

products.name: creative_asset
products.description: Master record for each creative asset and content item (TV commercial, digital banner, social post, print ad, packaging visual, influencer brief, video, blog post, email template) used in marketing campaigns or published on owned/earned channels. Captures asset name, format, dimensions, file type, brand, campaign association, creative concept, approval status, rights/usage restrictions, expiry date, DAM reference ID, and content publishing metadata (planned publish date, actual publish date, publishing channel, content status, content type, target audience segment, content owner). Serves as the unified creative and content management record supporting brand compliance, creative reuse tracking, DAM integration, and coordinated omnichannel content calendar planning. No separate content calendar product exists — all scheduling and publishing metadata lives here.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the creative asset record. Primary key.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign this creative asset is associated with.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual or team responsible for the creative asset content and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: label_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.label_version. Business justification: Creative assets used in label design must be tied to the specific label version for regulatory approval traceability.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand associated with this creative asset.

attributes.name: parent_asset_creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent creative asset if this asset is a derivative, localized version, or variant of another asset.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Creative assets (images, packaging) are created per SKU; linking enables asset tracking, compliance, and reuse.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the creative asset was withdrawn or archived from active use.

attributes.name: actual_publish_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the creative asset was published or went live.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the creative asset in the review workflow (draft, pending review, approved, rejected, expired).

attributes.name: asset_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code assigned to the creative asset for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the creative asset (e.g., 'Spring Campaign Hero Banner', 'Product Launch Video 30s').

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the creative asset by media type (video, image, audio, document, HTML, social post, email template). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: video|image|audio|document|html|social_post|email_template — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Notes or comments from compliance and legal review regarding the creative asset.

attributes.name: compliance_review_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory and legal compliance review for the creative asset (not required, pending, approved, rejected).

products.name: influencer
products.description: Master record for influencer and content creator partners engaged by Consumer Goods, including full engagement/activation history. Captures influencer handle, platform(s), follower count, engagement rate, audience demographics, content category, tier (nano, micro, macro, mega), brand safety score, contract status, preferred contact, and historical campaign participation. Engagement detail records capture: engagement type (sponsored post, product seeding, brand ambassador, event appearance), campaign association, contracted deliverables, content submission dates, approval status, agreed fee, actual fee paid, platform, post URLs, reach, impressions, engagement metrics, and content performance. Serves as the SSOT for influencer partner identity, roster management, and all activation history. No separate engagement product exists — all engagement transactional data lives here as detail records.

products.name: brand_health_tracker
products.description: Consolidated periodic brand performance scorecard capturing all consumer perception, market position, competitive share, media share, and social sentiment metrics for a brand in a specific market and time period. Captures awareness (spontaneous, aided), consideration, preference, purchase intent, NPS, brand equity index, SOV% (Share of Voice by channel — TV, digital, OOH, social), SOM% (value share, volume share by category/channel/geography), total category spend, competitor benchmarks, social sentiment scores (positive/neutral/negative breakdown), mention volume, share of conversation, platform distribution, net sentiment score, and key image attribute scores. Sourced from Nielsen Ad Intel/Kantar media monitoring (SOV), Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement/Circana (SOM), proprietary brand tracking studies (awareness/equity), and social listening platforms (sentiment). Serves as the single authoritative brand scorecard enabling longitudinal brand health monitoring, SOV vs. SOM gap analysis, competitive benchmarking, market share trend tracking, and sentiment trend analysis.

products.description: Periodic Share of Voice (SOV) measurement record capturing a brand's advertising share relative to total category spend across media channels, market, and time period. Captures brand SOV%, competitor SOV%, total category spend, brand spend, channel (TV, digital, OOH, social), data source (Nielsen Ad Intel, Kantar), and measurement period. Enables SOV vs. SOM gap analysis.
products.reference: SOV (Share of Voice) / Nielsen Ad Intel

attributes.name: sov_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Share of Voice measurement record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing analyst or user who created or validated the Share of Voice measurement record.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand being measured for Share of Voice.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category for which Share of Voice is measured.

attributes.name: brand_rank
attributes.description: Rank of the brand by Share of Voice within the category (1 = highest SOV).

attributes.name: brand_som_percentage
attributes.description: The brand's Share of Market (sales-based market share) during the same measurement period, used for SOV vs. SOM gap analysis.

attributes.name: brand_sov_percentage
attributes.description: The brand's Share of Voice as a percentage of total category advertising spend during the measurement period.

attributes.name: brand_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total advertising spend by the brand during the measurement period.

attributes.name: competitor_count
attributes.description: Number of competitor brands included in the category Share of Voice calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the Share of Voice measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for spend amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or vendor providing the Share of Voice measurement data (e.g., Nielsen Ad Intel, Kantar Media, Comscore).

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times the target audience was exposed to the brand's advertising during the measurement period.

attributes.name: grp
attributes.description: Gross Rating Points achieved by the brand during the measurement period, representing reach multiplied by frequency.

attributes.name: impressions_count
attributes.description: Total number of advertising impressions delivered by the brand during the measurement period.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Share of Voice measurement record is currently active (True) or archived (False).

attributes.name: market_geography
attributes.description: Geographic market where the Share of Voice is measured (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date when the Share of Voice measurement was calculated and recorded.

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate Share of Voice (e.g., spend-based, impression-based, GRP-based).

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the Share of Voice measurement period.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the Share of Voice measurement period.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Status of the Share of Voice measurement record (Preliminary, Final, Revised, Archived).

attributes.name: media_channel
attributes.description: Media channel through which advertising spend is measured (TV, Digital, Radio, Print, Out-of-Home, Social Media).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the Share of Voice measurement record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or commentary regarding the Share of Voice measurement, including data quality issues, anomalies, or contextual information.

attributes.name: reach_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the target audience reached by the brand's advertising during the measurement period.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Share of Voice measurement record in the source system.

attributes.name: sov_som_gap
attributes.business_glossary_term: Share of Voice (SOV) vs Share of Market (SOM) Gap
attributes.description: Difference between brand SOV percentage and brand SOM percentage (SOV - SOM). Positive gap indicates over-investment; negative gap indicates under-investment.

tag_set.value: Share of Voice (SOV) vs Share of Market (SOM) Gap

attributes.name: top_competitor_brand_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor brand with the highest Share of Voice in the category during the measurement period.

attributes.name: top_competitor_sov_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Top Competitor Share of Voice (SOV) Percentage
attributes.description: Share of Voice percentage of the top competitor brand in the category.

tag_set.value: Top Competitor Share of Voice (SOV) Percentage

attributes.name: total_category_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total advertising spend across all brands in the category during the measurement period.

products.name: digital_performance
products.description: Transactional record of digital campaign performance metrics captured at the campaign-channel-date grain. Captures impressions, clicks, CTR, video views, view-through rate, conversions, cost-per-click (CPC), cost-per-acquisition (CPA), ROAS (Return on Ad Spend), reach, frequency, and platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic DSP). Sourced from digital ad platforms via API integration.

attributes.name: digital_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital campaign performance record. Primary key for this transactional performance measurement entity.

attributes.name: analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Digital performance metrics are compiled by a marketing analyst; link enables attribution of analysis effort and audit.

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific campaign flight or wave. Links this performance record to the flight-level execution plan.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign. Links this performance record to the campaign master data.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific creative asset used in this campaign execution. Links performance to creative master data for creative effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand being promoted in this campaign. Links performance to brand master data for brand-level reporting.

attributes.name: ad_format
attributes.description: The specific creative format of the digital ad (e.g., carousel, single image, video, story, banner, interstitial, native). Describes the presentation style of the creative asset.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: The attribution methodology used to assign conversion credit to this touchpoint. Defines how conversions are credited across the customer journey.
attributes.value_regex: Last Click|First Click|Linear|Time Decay|Position Based|Data Driven

attributes.name: attribution_window_days
attributes.description: The number of days after ad interaction during which conversions are attributed to this campaign. Defines the lookback period for conversion tracking.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The digital marketing channel type. Categorizes the advertising medium (social, search, display, video, programmatic, native, email). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Social|Search|Display|Video|Programmatic|Native|Email — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Total number of clicks on the ad. Measures user engagement and intent to interact with the campaign.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate expressed as a decimal (conversions divided by clicks). Measures the effectiveness of the ad in driving desired actions.

attributes.name: conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions attributed to this campaign on this date and channel. Represents completed desired actions (purchase, sign-up, download, etc.) as defined by the campaign objective.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total media spend for this campaign on this date and channel. Represents the actual cost incurred for ad delivery.

attributes.name: cpa
attributes.description: Average cost per conversion (total cost divided by conversions). Measures the efficiency of conversion-focused campaigns.

attributes.name: cpc
attributes.description: Average cost per click (total cost divided by clicks). Key efficiency metric for click-based campaigns.

attributes.name: cpm
attributes.description: Cost per thousand impressions (total cost divided by impressions, multiplied by 1000). Standard metric for awareness campaigns.

attributes.name: ctr
attributes.description: Click-through rate expressed as a decimal (clicks divided by impressions). Key engagement metric indicating ad relevance and creative effectiveness.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency campaign performance tracking.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or API from which this performance data was ingested (e.g., Meta Ads API, Google Ads API, TikTok Ads Manager). Tracks data lineage and integration source.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The device category on which the ad was served and performance was measured. Segments performance by device form factor.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times each unique user saw the ad (impressions divided by reach). Measures ad exposure intensity per user.

attributes.name: geography
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the geographic market where the ad was served. Enables market-level performance analysis.

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: Total number of times the ad was displayed to users. Represents the reach volume of the campaign on this date and channel.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was ingested into the lakehouse from the source platform API. Supports data freshness monitoring and audit trail.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance record is currently active and should be included in reporting. Supports soft-delete and data quality management.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this digital performance was measured and recorded. Represents the business event timestamp for this transactional record at campaign-channel-date grain.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The specific placement or inventory type within the platform (e.g., feed, stories, in-stream, search results, display network). Identifies where the ad appeared within the platform ecosystem.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The digital advertising platform where the campaign was executed. Identifies the ad network or publisher platform (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic DSP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Meta|Google|TikTok|Programmatic DSP|YouTube|LinkedIn|Twitter — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The product category being promoted in this campaign. Enables category-level performance analysis and cross-category comparison.

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Total number of unique users who saw the ad at least once. Measures unduplicated audience size exposed to the campaign.

attributes.name: revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue attributed to conversions from this campaign on this date and channel. Used to calculate ROAS and campaign profitability.

attributes.name: roas
attributes.description: Return on ad spend expressed as a ratio (revenue generated divided by cost). Key profitability metric for performance marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the target audience segment for this campaign execution. Defines the demographic, behavioral, or interest-based targeting criteria applied.

attributes.name: video_completion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that were watched to completion. Expressed as a decimal. Measures video creative engagement quality.

attributes.name: video_quartile_25_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that reached the 25% completion point. Expressed as a decimal. Tracks early engagement drop-off.

attributes.name: video_quartile_50_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that reached the 50% completion point (midpoint). Expressed as a decimal. Measures sustained viewer interest.

attributes.name: video_quartile_75_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that reached the 75% completion point. Expressed as a decimal. Indicates strong creative engagement.

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: Total number of video views for video ad formats. Counts views meeting the platforms minimum view threshold (typically 3 seconds or more).

attributes.name: view_through_conversions
attributes.description: Number of conversions attributed to users who viewed but did not click the ad, then converted within the attribution window. Measures passive ad influence.

products.name: attribution
products.description: Marketing attribution record linking consumer purchase or conversion events to contributing marketing touchpoints (campaign, channel, creative) using a defined attribution model (last-touch, first-touch, linear, data-driven, MTA). Captures attributed revenue, attributed conversions, attribution model type, touchpoint sequence, channel contribution weight, and brand. Enables ROI measurement across the marketing mix.

attributes.name: attribution_id
attributes.description: Primary key for attribution

attributes.name: analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Attribution models are maintained by an analyst; linking provides accountability and traceability for model changes.

attributes.name: attribution_product_sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product purchased or converted in the attributed event.

attributes.name: attribution_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Attribution models assign conversion revenue to specific SKUs; FK ensures accurate SKU‑level performance metrics.

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific campaign flight (time-bound execution) receiving attribution credit.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign receiving attribution credit for this conversion.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the creative asset (ad, banner, video) shown at this touchpoint.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the brand associated with the attributed conversion.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the consumer who completed the conversion or purchase event.

attributes.name: attributed_conversions
attributes.description: Fractional conversion count credited to this touchpoint (e.g., 0.25 conversions for 25% attribution weight).

attributes.name: attributed_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount credited to this touchpoint based on the attribution weight.

attributes.name: attribution_status
attributes.description: Status of the attribution record (final, provisional, recalculated, voided).

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the attribution calculation was performed.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Marketing channel that received attribution credit (paid search, organic search, display, social media, email, affiliate, direct, referral, video, mobile app, TV, radio, print, outdoor, in-store). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paid_search|organic_search|display|social_media|email|affiliate|direct|referral|video|mobile_app|tv|radio|print|outdoor|in_store — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: conversion_event_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the conversion event (purchase, sign-up, download) being attributed.

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the conversion event occurred.

attributes.name: conversion_type
attributes.description: Type of conversion event being attributed (purchase, add-to-cart, sign-up, download, lead, subscription, trial, engagement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|add_to_cart|sign_up|download|lead|subscription|trial|engagement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cpa
attributes.description: Cost per acquisition for this attributed touchpoint (media spend attributed / attributed conversions).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this attribution record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for attributed revenue amount.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or platform that provided the attribution data (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, internal MTA platform, etc.).

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer at this touchpoint (desktop, mobile, tablet, smart TV, wearable, other).

attributes.name: geography
attributes.description: Three-letter country code where the conversion occurred.

attributes.name: is_direct_conversion
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this was a direct conversion with no prior touchpoints (True/False).

attributes.name: is_view_through
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this touchpoint was a view-through impression (ad viewed but not clicked) (True/False).

attributes.name: lookback_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the attribution lookback window used to identify contributing touchpoints.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Consumer market segment targeted by the attributed campaign.

attributes.name: media_spend_attributed_amount
attributes.description: Portion of media spend allocated to this touchpoint based on attribution weight.

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: Type of attribution model applied to assign credit (last-touch, first-touch, linear, time-decay, position-based, data-driven MTA).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this attribution record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about this attribution record.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Digital platform or publisher where the touchpoint occurred (Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).

attributes.name: roas
attributes.description: Return on Ad Spend calculated for this attributed touchpoint (attributed revenue / media spend attributed).

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code of the product involved in the conversion event.

attributes.name: time_to_conversion_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours elapsed between this touchpoint and the final conversion event.

attributes.name: total_touchpoints
attributes.description: Total number of marketing touchpoints in the consumer journey leading to this conversion.

attributes.name: touchpoint_sequence_number
attributes.description: Position of this touchpoint in the consumer journey sequence (1 = first touch, N = last touch).

attributes.name: touchpoint_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specific marketing touchpoint occurred.

attributes.name: weight
attributes.description: Fractional credit assigned to this touchpoint by the attribution model (0.0000 to 1.0000, sum across all touchpoints = 1.0).

products.name: social_listening_record
products.description: Transactional record of social media listening and sentiment monitoring results for a brand, product, or topic at a given time period. Captures mention volume, sentiment breakdown (positive, neutral, negative), share of conversation, top themes, platform distribution (Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube), net sentiment score, and data source. Enables consumer sentiment trend analysis and brand reputation monitoring.

attributes.name: social_listening_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the social listening record.

attributes.name: analyst_employee_id

attributes.name: category_id

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: competitive_brand_mention_flag

attributes.name: country_codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: crisis_alert_flag

attributes.name: data_collection_timestamp

attributes.name: data_source_provider

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: monitoring_topic

attributes.name: negative_mention_count

attributes.name: net_sentiment_score

attributes.name: neutral_mention_count

attributes.name: positive_mention_count

attributes.name: sentiment_analysis_model

attributes.name: share_of_conversation_percent

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: tiktok_mention_count

attributes.name: top_theme_2

products.name: nielsen_panel_insight
products.description: Periodic consumer panel insight record sourced from Nielsen IQ panel data. Captures category, brand, SKU-level household penetration, purchase frequency, basket size, repeat rate, switching behavior, buyer profile demographics, and panel period. Serves as the authoritative source for Nielsen IQ consumer panel metrics used in brand and category strategy decisions.

attributes.name: nielsen_panel_insight_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Nielsen panel insight record. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Nielsen insights are analyzed by a market analyst; link supports audit of insight generation and analyst KPI.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the product category to which this panel insight applies.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the brand to which this panel insight applies.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific SKU to which this panel insight applies. Nullable for category or brand-level insights.

attributes.name: average_basket_size
attributes.description: Average quantity (units or volume) purchased per transaction by buying households during the panel period.

attributes.name: average_price_per_unit
attributes.description: Average price paid per unit or volume by panel households during the panel period.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Name of the brand measured in this panel insight.

attributes.name: brand_switching_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of households that switched from this brand to a competitor brand during the panel period. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: buyer_age_group
attributes.description: Age group classification of the primary buyer in panel households.

attributes.name: buyer_household_size
attributes.description: Number of people in the buying household.

attributes.name: buyer_income_bracket
attributes.description: Annual household income bracket of the primary buyer in panel households.

attributes.name: buyer_presence_of_children
attributes.description: Indicates whether children are present in the buying household.

attributes.name: buyer_profile_segment
attributes.description: Demographic or psychographic segment classification of the primary buyer households (e.g., Millennials with Kids, Affluent Seniors, Budget-Conscious Families).

attributes.name: buying_households_count
attributes.description: Number of panel households that purchased the category, brand, or SKU during the panel period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this panel insight record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total spend amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: data_extract_date
attributes.description: Date when this panel insight data was extracted from the Nielsen IQ source system.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which this panel insight was extracted (e.g., Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel, Nielsen Homescan).

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The GTIN (UPC, EAN) of the SKU measured in this panel insight. Nullable for category or brand-level insights.

attributes.name: household_penetration_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of panel households that purchased the category, brand, or SKU during the panel period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2345 = 23.45%).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel insight record is currently active and valid for use in analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: loyalty_index
attributes.description: Nielsen IQ loyalty index score measuring the strength of repeat purchase behavior for this brand or SKU. Higher values indicate stronger loyalty.

attributes.name: market_geography
attributes.description: Geographic market or region covered by this panel insight (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: measurement_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level of aggregation for this panel insight: category-level, brand-level, or SKU-level.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this panel insight record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: panel_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Nielsen consumer panel from which this insight was derived.

attributes.name: panel_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the panel measurement period for which this insight was captured.

attributes.name: panel_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the panel measurement period for which this insight was captured.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label of the product measured in this panel insight.

attributes.name: purchase_frequency
attributes.description: Average number of purchase occasions per buying household during the panel period.

attributes.name: repeat_purchase_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of buying households that made more than one purchase during the panel period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65%).

attributes.name: share_of_category_spend
attributes.description: Percentage of total category spend captured by this brand or SKU within the panel. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.5%).

attributes.name: share_of_category_volume
attributes.description: Percentage of total category volume (units) captured by this brand or SKU within the panel. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: total_panel_households

attributes.name: total_purchase_occasions
attributes.description: Total number of purchase transactions recorded for the category, brand, or SKU during the panel period.

attributes.name: total_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount spent by panel households on the category, brand, or SKU during the panel period.

attributes.name: total_units_purchased
attributes.description: Total quantity (units or volume) of the category, brand, or SKU purchased by panel households during the panel period.

Serves as the SSOT for agency partner identity and roster management within the marketing domain. Enables agency performance benchmarking and spend consolidation analysis.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns financial planning, accounting, and reporting including general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, cost accounting, COGS allocation, EBITDA reporting, DSO/DIO tracking, budgeting, revenue recognition, and SOX-compliant financial controls and audit trails. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and Oracle Cloud Financials.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for organizational cost centers used in SAP S/4HANA CO module. Defines the financial accountability units within the CPG enterprise — brand units, manufacturing plants, regional sales offices, and shared service centers. Each cost center carries a hierarchy path, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, currency, and active period. Serves as the foundational dimension for all cost accounting, COGS allocation, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master record in SAP S/4HANA CO module.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand budgeting process allocates cost‑center budgets to each brand for expense control and reporting.

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the manager accountable for this cost center's budget and performance. Used for approval workflows and variance analysis reporting.

attributes.name: activity_type_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this cost center performs activity-based costing. True if the center provides measurable activities (e.g., machine hours, labor hours) that are allocated to cost objects.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used for allocating costs from this cost center to other cost objects (products, profit centers). Critical for COGS calculation and overhead absorption.

attributes.name: budget_profile_code
attributes.description: Budget control profile defining budget planning rules, tolerance limits, and approval workflows for this cost center. Determines budget availability check behavior.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area classification for cross-company code reporting. Represents a distinct line of business or product category (e.g., Personal Care, Home Care, Beauty) for consolidated financial analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Accounting classification indicating whether costs are direct (attributable to products), indirect (supporting operations), overhead (administrative), or capital (asset-related). Critical for COGS calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cost center. Alphanumeric code used across SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules for financial accountability tracking. Typically follows organizational naming conventions (e.g., plant code + department code).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity company code in SAP S/4HANA FI module. Links cost center to the legal entity for statutory financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_group
attributes.description: Logical grouping of cost centers for consolidated reporting and analysis. Enables flexible aggregation beyond standard hierarchy (e.g., all brand marketing centers, all R&D centers).

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active centers accept postings; inactive centers are closed; blocked centers are temporarily suspended; planned centers are approved but not yet operational.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by functional area. Determines the nature of costs tracked and reporting hierarchy. Used for COGS allocation and EBITDA segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|sales|marketing|distribution|administration|research_development|quality_assurance|procurement|finance|shared_services — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the cost center operates. Supports multi-country financial consolidation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the cost center master record. Audit trail for SOX compliance and data governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cost center master record was created in the system. Audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for cost center transactions. Defines the local currency for budget planning and actual cost recording.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department or functional unit code within the organization. Provides granular classification for workforce planning and departmental cost analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Extended description providing additional context about the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities within the organization.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting. Distinguishes between manufacturing, sales, marketing, R&D, and administrative functions for COGS and operating expense allocation.

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: Standard hierarchy assignment for organizational reporting. Defines the cost center's position in the corporate hierarchy tree for roll-up reporting and budget consolidation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the cost center master record. Audit trail for change tracking and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cost center master record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Geographic location or site code for the cost center. Used for regional cost analysis and location-based reporting.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the cost center is locked for actual postings. Used during period-end close and organizational changes to prevent unintended transactions.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center. Human-readable label identifying the organizational unit (e.g., 'Brand Marketing - North America', 'Manufacturing Plant 01 - Production Line A').

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables hierarchical roll-up of costs for management reporting and budget aggregation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code associated with this cost center. Links production and logistics cost centers to physical facilities for COGS allocation.

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Version number of the cost center master record. Incremented with each modification to support change history tracking and optimistic locking.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region classification (e.g., NOAM, EMEA, APAC, LATAM) for regional financial reporting and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source ERP system from which this cost center record originated. Supports multi-system landscapes and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: statistical_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a statistical cost center used only for informational reporting without actual cost postings. Used for tracking non-financial metrics.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the cost center is valid and can accept cost postings. Supports time-dependent organizational changes and fiscal year transitions.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the cost center is valid. Nullable for open-ended cost centers. Used for organizational restructuring and cost center retirement.
