attributes.description: Email address of the profit center manager for financial reporting notifications and escalations.

attributes.name: responsible_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the business leader or manager accountable for the profit center's financial performance and operational results.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Segment code for external segment reporting per IFRS 8 and US GAAP ASC 280. Represents reportable operating segments for investor disclosures.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the profit center used in reports and dashboards for space-constrained displays.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements for publicly traded companies.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: State or province code for the profit center's location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code for the profit center's location. Used for tax reporting and compliance with local tax authorities.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date from which this profit center is active and available for transaction postings. Supports time-dependent organizational structures.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date after which this profit center is no longer active. Null value indicates an open-ended validity period.

attributes.name: valuation_view
attributes.description: Valuation perspective for profit center accounting: legal (statutory), group (IFRS/GAAP consolidation), profit center (internal transfer pricing), or management (operational view).

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General ledger chart of accounts master for the consumer goods enterprise. Defines every account in the COA including P&L accounts (revenue, COGS, trade spend, marketing, SG&A), balance sheet accounts (inventory, AR, AP, fixed assets), and statistical accounts. Stores account type, financial statement category, tax category, reconciliation account flag, currency, and controlling relevance. Source of truth for all financial postings in SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle Cloud Financials.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account. Primary key for the GL account master data.

attributes.name: account_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: GL account ownership required for audit trails and SOX compliance; reports list responsible employee per account.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset. Business justification: Accounting for carbon offset purchases uses dedicated GL accounts; linking enables accurate carbon credit financial reporting.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chart of accounts framework to which this account belongs. Links to the chart_of_accounts master data.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company code (legal entity) to which this GL account belongs. Links to the company_code master data.

attributes.name: controlling_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlling area for cost accounting and management reporting. Links to the controlling_area master data.

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: The account group classification that controls field status, number ranges, and posting rules in the ERP system.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the GL account as it appears in financial reports and statements.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number in the chart of accounts. This is the business identifier used in financial postings and reporting.

attributes.name: account_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or label for the GL account used in condensed reports and system displays.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the GL account: active (in use), inactive (not currently used but retained), pending approval (awaiting activation), or archived (historical only).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account: asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense, or statistical (non-monetary).

attributes.name: balance_sheet_classification
attributes.description: For balance sheet accounts, indicates whether the account is a current asset, non-current asset, current liability, non-current liability, or equity. Not applicable for P&L accounts.

attributes.name: blocked_for_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is currently blocked for all postings. Used to prevent transactions to accounts that are under review, closed, or being restructured.

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether budget availability checking is active for this account. When enabled, postings are validated against approved budgets.

attributes.name: cash_flow_category
attributes.description: For accounts that impact cash flow, indicates the cash flow statement category: operating activities, investing activities, or financing activities. Not applicable for non-cash accounts.

attributes.name: consolidation_account_number
attributes.description: The corresponding account number in the group consolidation chart of accounts. Used for mapping local accounts to group reporting structures.

attributes.name: cost_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. Used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: For accounts that are cost elements, indicates whether it is a primary cost element (direct posting from FI) or secondary cost element (internal allocation only). Not applicable if not a cost element.

attributes.name: cost_element_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is also defined as a cost element in the Controlling (CO) module for cost center and internal order postings.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this GL account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account's local currency. For multi-currency accounts, this is the primary reporting currency.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit balance or credit balance in the general ledger.

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: The field status group that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this account.

attributes.name: financial_statement_category
attributes.description: The primary financial statement where this account appears: balance sheet, income statement (P&L), cash flow statement, retained earnings, or statistical.

attributes.name: financial_statement_line_item
attributes.description: The specific line item or section within the financial statement where this account balance is reported (e.g., Current Assets, Cost of Goods Sold, Operating Expenses).

attributes.name: intercompany_clearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions that require clearing and elimination in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this GL account record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was last modified.

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line item details are stored and can be displayed for this account. Required for detailed transaction analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses open item management for tracking and clearing individual line items (e.g., AR, AP, bank clearing accounts).

attributes.name: pl_category
attributes.description: For income statement accounts, indicates the P&L category: gross revenue, net revenue, COGS, gross margin, operating expense (SG&A, marketing, trade spend), EBITDA, EBIT, or net income. Not applicable for balance sheet accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gross_revenue|net_revenue|cogs|gross_margin|operating_expense|ebitda|ebit|net_income|not_applicable — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: The organizational level at which budget planning and forecasting is performed for this account (e.g., company code, profit center, cost center).

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct postings are allowed to this account. Some accounts (e.g., summary or control accounts) may only accept postings from automated processes.

attributes.name: profit_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that summarizes detailed transactions from subsidiary ledgers such as AR, AP, or inventory.

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the retained earnings account where net income/loss is transferred during year-end closing.

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: The default sort key used for organizing and displaying line items within this account (e.g., posting date, document number, amount).

attributes.name: sox_control_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to SOX internal control requirements and enhanced audit procedures.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax treatment category for this account (e.g., taxable revenue, non-taxable revenue, input tax, output tax, tax-exempt). Used for VAT, sales tax, and GST reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tax codes can be entered when posting to this account. Typically true for revenue and expense accounts, false for balance sheet accounts.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account is valid and available for posting. Used for time-dependent account structures.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this GL account is valid. After this date, the account is no longer available for posting. Null indicates no end date.

products.name: ledger
products.description: Financial ledger master defining the accounting ledgers maintained in the enterprise — leading ledger (IFRS/GAAP), parallel ledgers for local GAAP, and extension ledgers for management reporting. Each ledger record captures ledger type, accounting principle, currency type, fiscal year variant, and posting period variant. Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements common in global CPG companies operating across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.
products.reference: SAP FI Ledger / Oracle Cloud Ledger

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial ledger record. Primary key for the ledger entity.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.chart_of_accounts

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.company_code

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ledger stewardship is tracked for consolidation control and audit; responsible employee must be recorded.

attributes.name: accounting_principle
attributes.description: The accounting standard or principle applied in this ledger, such as International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP), local country-specific GAAP, tax accounting rules, or management accounting conventions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether comprehensive audit trail logging is enabled for all postings and changes to this ledger, supporting regulatory compliance and forensic analysis.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the base currency in which this ledger maintains balances (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the ledger within the enterprise. Used as the business identifier for the ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle Cloud Financials.

attributes.name: consolidation_ledger_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger is used for group consolidation purposes, aggregating financial data from multiple legal entities for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this ledger record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for ledger lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Defines the currency perspective maintained in this ledger. Local currency represents the operating entity's functional currency, group currency is the consolidated reporting currency, hard currency is a stable reference currency (e.g., USD, EUR), and index currency supports inflation-adjusted reporting.

attributes.name: ledger_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the ledger's purpose, scope, and usage within the enterprise financial reporting architecture. Provides context for finance users and auditors.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ledger ceases to be active and no longer accepts financial postings. Null for ledgers with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ledger becomes active and begins accepting financial postings. Supports temporal validity for ledger lifecycle management.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Code identifying the fiscal year calendar structure used by this ledger, defining the number of posting periods, special periods, and year-end closing rules. Common in SAP S/4HANA FI to support diverse fiscal calendars across global entities.

attributes.name: is_leading_ledger
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the leading ledger (primary book of record) for the company code. Only one ledger per company code can be designated as the leading ledger.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this ledger record. Supports change tracking and audit trail for ledger configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this ledger record was last modified. Enables change tracking and supports audit trail requirements for financial system configuration.

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ledger. Active ledgers accept postings, inactive ledgers are configured but not yet in use, closed ledgers are archived and no longer accept postings, and suspended ledgers are temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ledger indicating its role in the financial reporting architecture. Leading ledger is the primary book of record, parallel ledgers support alternative accounting principles (e.g., local GAAP), and extension ledgers provide management reporting views.

attributes.name: ledger_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the ledger for human-readable identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Code defining the posting period structure for this ledger, including the number of regular periods (typically 12 monthly periods) and special periods for year-end adjustments and closing entries.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that financial data in this ledger must be retained to comply with statutory, tax, and regulatory record-keeping requirements. Common retention periods range from 7 to 10 years for financial records.

attributes.name: sox_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger maintains controls and audit trails compliant with Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404 requirements for internal controls over financial reporting.

attributes.name: supports_cost_of_sales_accounting
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supports Cost of Sales (COGS) Accounting Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports cost of sales (COGS) accounting method, which matches costs directly to revenue in the period of sale, as opposed to period-based cost accounting.

tag_set.value: Supports Cost of Sales (COGS) Accounting Flag

attributes.name: supports_profit_center_accounting
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger maintains profit center accounting data for internal management reporting and profitability analysis by organizational unit.

attributes.name: supports_segment_reporting
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ledger supports segment reporting as required by IFRS 8 Operating Segments. Segment reporting enables financial analysis by business unit, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: valuation_view
attributes.description: Defines the valuation perspective applied in this ledger. Legal valuation follows statutory requirements, group valuation applies consolidated group policies, profit center valuation supports internal management reporting, and cost center valuation tracks cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this ledger record in the system. Supports audit trail and accountability for ledger configuration changes.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core general ledger journal entry header capturing every financial posting in the consumer goods enterprise. Records document type (vendor invoice, customer payment, goods issue, payroll posting, accrual, reversal), posting date, fiscal period, company code, ledger, currency, exchange rate, reference document, and SOX-compliant posting user and approval chain. The authoritative transactional record for all financial activity sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle Cloud Financials.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry header.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center to which costs or revenues from this journal entry are allocated. Used for management accounting and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entries reference GL accounts by code; adding gl_account_id FK normalizes the relationship and removes the redundant code column.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Journal entries belong to a specific ledger; adding ledger_id FK links each entry to its ledger without removing existing ledger_group (kept for reporting).

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who posted or created this journal entry. Critical for SOX compliance and audit trail. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Used for EBITDA calculation by business unit.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: R&D expense tracking mandates associating journal entries with the originating RD project for cost accounting and project profitability reporting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the journal entry was approved. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: The baseline date used for calculating payment terms and due dates for vendor invoices and customer receivables. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch input session if this journal entry was created through automated batch processing. Used for tracking mass data uploads and interface postings.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Code representing the business area or division for cross-company code reporting. Used for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared. Used for DSO and DIO calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing document if this open item has been cleared (paid or offset). Used for accounts payable and receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the legal entity or business unit within the enterprise. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Organizational unit in management accounting that represents a closed system for cost accounting. Used for internal management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the document currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document (invoice, receipt, payment voucher). May differ from posting date. Used for document control and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the accounting document within the company code and fiscal year. This is the externally visible business key for the journal entry.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification code indicating the nature and source of the journal entry. Examples: SA (General Ledger Document), AB (Accounting Document), KR (Vendor Invoice), DR (Customer Invoice), DZ (Customer Payment), KA (Vendor Payment), KG (Vendor Credit Memo), KN (Customer Credit Memo), KZ (Payment Request), RE (Invoice Receipt), RV (Invoice Reversal), WA (Goods Issue), WE (Goods Receipt), ZP (Payment Posting). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|KR|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KZ|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was created or entered into the system. Used for audit trail and process monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert document currency amounts to local currency. Expressed as local currency per one unit of document currency. Null if document currency equals local currency.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: Code indicating the type of exchange rate used for currency translation. Examples: M (Average Rate), B (Bank Buying Rate), G (Bank Selling Rate), P (Posting Date Rate).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric period within the fiscal year (typically 1-12 for monthly periods, or 1-13 for year-end adjustments). Determines the reporting period for financial statements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year representing the fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code classifying the journal entry by functional area (e.g., Production, Sales, Administration, R&D). Used for cost of goods sold (COGS) allocation and functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information or explanation about the journal entry. Used for documentation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany transactions between different company codes within the enterprise. True if intercompany, False otherwise.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger or accounting principle under which this entry is recorded. Examples: 0L (Leading Ledger - IFRS), 2L (Local GAAP), 3L (Management Reporting). Supports parallel accounting for multiple reporting standards.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the company code local currency. All amounts are translated to this currency for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this document (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Used for cash flow forecasting and DSO tracking.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial reporting and determines the fiscal period assignment. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Values: draft (entry created but not posted), posted (entry successfully posted to GL), parked (entry saved for later posting), cancelled (entry voided before posting), reversed (entry reversed by a subsequent document).

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (invoice number, purchase order number, payment reference). Used for cross-referencing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal document, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original document. Examples: 01 (Reversal in Current Period), 02 (Reversal in Next Period), 03 (Correction), 04 (Accrual Reversal), 05 (Error Correction), 06 (Period-End Adjustment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|03|04|05|06|07|08|09 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original journal entry that is being reversed by this entry. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this journal entry originated. Examples: SAP_FI (SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting), SAP_CO (SAP Controlling), ORACLE_GL (Oracle Cloud General Ledger), ORACLE_AP (Oracle Accounts Payable), ORACLE_AR (Oracle Accounts Receivable), SFDC (Salesforce), WMS (Warehouse Management System), MES (Manufacturing Execution System). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_FI|SAP_CO|ORACLE_GL|ORACLE_AP|ORACLE_AR|SFDC|WMS|MES — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures. True if SOX-controlled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date relevant for tax reporting purposes. May differ from posting date based on tax jurisdiction rules. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner if this is an intercompany transaction. Used for consolidation and elimination entries. Null if not an intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code or Oracle program identifier used to create this journal entry. Examples: FB01 (Post Document), FB50 (G/L Account Posting), MIRO (Enter Invoice), F-28 (Post Incoming Payments). Used for audit trail and process analysis.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual line items of a general ledger journal entry. Each line captures the GL account, cost center, profit center, WBS element, business area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction currency, amount in company code currency, amount in group currency, tax code, and assignment field. Enables granular cost allocation, COGS decomposition, and audit trail tracing at the line level as required by SOX compliance.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry Line Item (BSEG)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for granular cost allocation, COGS decomposition, and SOX-compliant audit trail tracing at the line level.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entry lines store GL account code; FK to gl_account enables proper account lookup and eliminates duplicate code.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header document. Links this line to the overall journal entry batch and posting context.

attributes.name: amount_company_code_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount converted to the local currency of the company code. Used for statutory reporting and local GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount converted to the group reporting currency. Enables consolidated financial reporting across all subsidiaries.

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount of this line item in the original transaction currency. Preserves the original posting amount before currency conversion.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text assignment field for additional reference information such as invoice number, purchase order, or payment reference. Enhances traceability.

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Used to compute due dates and cash discount periods.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area classification for cross-company code segment reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements by business segment.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this open item was cleared or settled. Null if the item remains open.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that settled this open item. Null if the item remains open.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity identifier representing the company or subsidiary for which this line is posted. Enables consolidated and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: company_code_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company code local currency. Typically the statutory reporting currency of the legal entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer account number for revenue and receivables postings. Links financial transactions to customer master data.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and account balance calculation.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due for payables or expected for receivables. Critical for DSO and cash flow management.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to company code or group currency. Critical for currency translation audit trail.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification (e.g., production, sales, administration, R&D). Supports cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the group reporting currency. Typically USD or EUR for multinational consumer goods companies.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Internal order for tracking costs of short-term jobs, events, or overhead activities. Enables job costing and overhead allocation.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry header. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the document.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Material or SKU associated with this line item for inventory and COGS postings. Links financial postings to product master data.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to this line item. Determines due date calculation and cash discount eligibility.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center associated with this line item. Supports plant-level cost accounting and inventory management.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit posting key controlling account type, debit/credit indicator, and field status. Fundamental to SAP FI posting logic.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or units associated with this line item. Enables unit cost calculation and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External or internal document number referenced by this line (e.g., invoice, purchase order, contract). Supports document linkage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a previous posting. True if this is a reversal entry.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original entry that this line reverses. Null if this is not a reversal.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: Special GL indicator for down payments, bills of exchange, guarantees, or other special transactions. Enables special ledger processing.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location within the plant for inventory-related postings. Enables warehouse-level inventory tracking and valuation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item in transaction currency. Supports VAT, sales tax, and other indirect tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code determining the tax treatment of this line item. Drives automatic tax calculation and tax reporting compliance.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Descriptive text explaining the nature or purpose of this journal entry line. Provides human-readable context for audit and review.

attributes.name: trading_partner_code

products.name: cogs_allocation

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master and lifecycle record for capital assets owned by the consumer goods enterprise — manufacturing equipment, production lines, warehouse automation, vehicles, buildings, and IT infrastructure. Covers the full asset lifecycle: acquisition, capitalization, depreciation, transfer, revaluation, impairment, and disposal. Captures asset class, description, acquisition date/cost, useful life, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, net book value, plant/location, responsible cost center, and all transaction events (transaction type, posting date, amount, document reference, originating business process). Supports capex tracking, depreciation run reconciliation, asset lifecycle audit trail, and SOX-compliant fixed asset management. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-AA and Oracle Cloud Fixed Assets.

products.name: sox_control
products.description: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) internal control record defining and tracking the financial controls framework for the consumer goods enterprise. Covers the full control lifecycle: definition, testing, remediation, and certification. Captures control ID, name, objective, type (preventive/detective), frequency, risk area, responsible owner, test date, test method (inquiry, observation, inspection, re-performance), sample size, exceptions identified, remediation status, remediation due date, effectiveness rating, and test conclusion. Supports SOX 302/404 compliance, internal audit management, control deficiency tracking, and external auditor evidence packages.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SOX control record. Primary key for the sox_control data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: primary_sox_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for executing and maintaining the control.

attributes.name: tertiary_sox_tester_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal auditor or external auditor who performed the most recent control test.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code to which this control applies, supporting multi-entity SOX compliance programs.

attributes.name: control_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the control, typically following organizational control numbering scheme (e.g., FIN-AP-001, FIN-GL-005).

attributes.name: control_documentation_link
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed control documentation, including control narratives, process flows, and evidence repositories.

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is performed or executed (e.g., daily reconciliation, monthly close review, event-driven approval).

attributes.name: control_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the control (e.g., 'Three-Way Match for Purchase Orders', 'Journal Entry Approval').

attributes.name: control_nature
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is performed manually by personnel, automated through system configuration, or semi-automated requiring both system and manual steps.

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: Detailed statement of what the control is designed to achieve, including the risk it mitigates and the assertion it supports (e.g., 'Ensure all vendor invoices are matched to purchase orders and receiving documents before payment to prevent unauthorized disbursements').

attributes.name: control_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the control owner for reporting and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: control_owner_title
attributes.description: Job title of the control owner (e.g., Accounts Payable Manager, Financial Controller, GL Accountant).

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control: active (in operation), inactive (temporarily suspended), under-review (being evaluated for changes), or retired (no longer applicable).

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its timing and purpose: preventive (stops errors before they occur), detective (identifies errors after occurrence), or corrective (remediates identified errors).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this control record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Severity classification of any identified control deficiency: none (no issues), control deficiency (minor issue), significant deficiency (important enough to merit attention), or material weakness (reasonable possibility of material misstatement).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this control was retired or superseded. Null for active controls.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this control became effective and operational.

attributes.name: effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Overall assessment of control effectiveness based on testing results: effective (operating as designed), ineffective (deficiency identified), not-tested (testing not yet performed), or not-applicable (control not in scope for current period).

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nature of exceptions identified during testing, including root cause analysis and impact assessment.

attributes.name: exceptions_identified_count
attributes.description: The number of exceptions or deviations identified during the most recent control test.

attributes.name: external_auditor_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm that reviewed this control (e.g., Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG).

attributes.name: external_auditor_reviewed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this control has been reviewed by external auditors (true) or only by internal audit (false).

attributes.name: financial_statement_assertion
attributes.description: The specific financial statement assertion that this control supports: existence (assets/liabilities exist), completeness (all transactions recorded), accuracy (amounts correct), valuation (proper measurement), rights and obligations (entity has legal claim), or presentation and disclosure (proper classification and disclosure).

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter for which this control test and assessment applies, supporting quarterly SOX certification requirements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this control test and assessment applies, supporting multi-year SOX compliance tracking.

attributes.name: itgc_dependent_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this control relies on IT general controls (true) or operates independently (false). ITGC-dependent controls require underlying IT controls to be effective.

attributes.name: key_control_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a key control (true) or supporting control (false). Key controls are critical to preventing or detecting material misstatements and receive heightened testing and monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this control record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which identified deficiencies must be remediated, typically driven by materiality and external audit timelines.

attributes.name: remediation_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on remediation activities, including actions taken, resources required, and progress updates.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation efforts for identified deficiencies: not-required (no deficiency), planned (remediation plan approved), in-progress (actively remediating), completed (remediation finished), or validated (remediation effectiveness confirmed).

attributes.name: risk_area
attributes.description: The financial statement area or business process that this control addresses (e.g., Revenue Recognition, Accounts Payable, Inventory Valuation, Financial Close, COGS Allocation).

attributes.name: test_conclusion
attributes.description: Detailed conclusion statement from the most recent control test, including auditor assessment, basis for conclusion, and any qualifications or limitations.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent control test was performed.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: The audit procedure used to test the control: inquiry (asking control owner), observation (watching control execution), inspection (examining evidence), re-performance (auditor executes control independently), or analytical review (comparing data patterns).

attributes.name: test_population_size
attributes.description: The total number of items or transactions in the population from which the test sample was drawn.

attributes.name: test_sample_size
attributes.description: The number of items or transactions selected for testing in the most recent control test.

attributes.name: tester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tester for audit trail and accountability purposes.

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Revenue recognition event record capturing the timing and amount of revenue recognized under ASC 606 / IFRS 15 for consumer goods sales transactions. Stores performance obligation ID, contract reference, recognition date, recognition method (point-in-time vs over-time), recognized revenue amount, deferred revenue amount, variable consideration estimate (trade promotions, rebates, returns), constraint applied flag, and cumulative catch-up adjustment. products.name: rd_project
products.description: Master record for all R&D and NPD projects in the innovation pipeline, from initial business opportunity through commercialization. Captures project identity, innovation brief details (target consumer, desired benefits, cost/RSP targets, competitive benchmarks, strategic fit rationale, key performance indicators), stage-gate phase, project type (new product, reformulation, line extension, cost optimization), target launch date, project sponsor, brand alignment, strategic priority tier, budget allocation, resource assignment, current milestone status, and the originating business opportunity context. Serves as the backbone of the R&D portfolio management function and links all downstream formulation, testing, regulatory, and scale-up activities. Subsumes the innovation brief as the project inception record.

products.name: inci_library
products.description: Enterprise master reference library and technical specification repository for all INCI ingredients and raw materials used across R&D formulations. Captures INCI name, CAS number, EC number, chemical family, function class, physical form, raw material code, supplier name, grade/quality level, specification parameters (purity, moisture content, particle size, color, odor), approved concentration range, regulatory status per major jurisdiction (EU REACH, FDA, Health Canada, ASEAN), restricted/prohibited flag, maximum permitted concentration, approved supplier grades, storage conditions, SDS reference, and R&D approval status. Serves as the single authoritative ingredient dictionary and raw material specification record for formulation development, regulatory compliance, and supplier qualification within R&D.
products.reference: INCI Dictionary / EU CosIng / FDA Ingredient Database

attributes.name: inci_library_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Library Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the INCI ingredient library record. Primary key for the enterprise master reference library of all INCI ingredients and raw materials used across R&D formulations.

tag_set.value: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Library Identifier

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: FK to procurement.supplier

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient is a known or potential allergen requiring special labeling or formulation considerations. True indicates allergen status.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the ingredient was approved for use in R&D formulations by the internal review committee. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_concentration_max_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum approved concentration level for use in formulations, expressed as a percentage. Based on safety assessments, regulatory limits, and stability considerations.

attributes.name: approved_concentration_min_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum approved concentration level for use in formulations, expressed as a percentage. Based on efficacy requirements and regulatory guidance.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Used for precise identification of chemical compounds in regulatory filings and safety documentation.

attributes.name: chemical_family
attributes.description: Broad chemical classification grouping of the ingredient (e.g., surfactants, emollients, polymers, preservatives, colorants, fragrances, botanical extracts, minerals, vitamins). Used for formulation planning and ingredient substitution analysis.

attributes.name: color_specification
attributes.description: Acceptable color range or specification for the raw material, often described using visual standards, Lovibond scale, or spectrophotometric values. Important for maintaining product appearance consistency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this INCI library record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit identifier assigned to chemical substances for regulatory purposes within the European Union. Also known as EINECS, ELINCS, or NLP number depending on the list.

attributes.name: function_class
attributes.description: Primary functional role of the ingredient in formulations (e.g., emulsifier, thickener, moisturizer, active ingredient, pH adjuster, antioxidant, UV filter, fragrance component). Multiple functions may be comma-separated.

attributes.name: grade_quality_level
attributes.description: Quality grade designation of the raw material (e.g., cosmetic grade, pharmaceutical grade, technical grade, food grade, USP, NF, BP, EP). Indicates purity level and intended application.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient has been certified as Halal-compliant for use in products targeting Muslim consumers. True indicates Halal certification.

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: The standardized INCI name of the ingredient as defined by the International Nomenclature Committee. This is the globally recognized ingredient name used on product labels and regulatory submissions.

tag_set.value: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient has been certified as Kosher-compliant for use in products targeting Jewish consumers. True indicates Kosher certification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this INCI library record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data currency verification.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or technical review of the ingredient specifications and approval status. Used to track review currency and trigger periodic re-evaluation.

attributes.name: maximum_permitted_concentration_percentage
attributes.description: The most restrictive maximum concentration limit imposed by any regulatory authority across all jurisdictions. Used as the global ceiling for formulation development.

attributes.name: moisture_content_max_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content expressed as a percentage. Excess moisture can affect stability, microbial growth, and formulation performance.

attributes.name: natural_origin_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient is derived from natural sources (plant, mineral, animal) as opposed to synthetic origin. Used for natural and organic product claims.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the ingredient specifications, regulatory status, and approval. Ensures ongoing compliance and specification currency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional technical notes, formulation guidance, handling precautions, compatibility information, or special considerations for R&D use.

attributes.name: odor_specification
attributes.description: Acceptable odor characteristics of the raw material (e.g., characteristic, mild, odorless, specific odor profile). Critical for fragrance-sensitive formulations and consumer acceptance.

attributes.name: particle_size_specification
attributes.description: Specification for particle size distribution, typically expressed as a range in microns or mesh size. Critical for powder ingredients affecting texture, dispersion, and sensory properties.

attributes.name: patent_protected_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient or its specific grade/formulation is protected by active patents. True indicates patent protection exists, requiring licensing or IP clearance.

attributes.name: physical_form
attributes.description: Physical state and form of the raw material at standard storage conditions. Critical for handling, storage, and processing requirements in manufacturing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: solid|liquid|powder|gel|paste|granule|flake|wax|oil|emulsion|suspension — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: prohibited_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient is prohibited for use in cosmetic or personal care products in any major jurisdiction. True indicates prohibition exists.

attributes.name: purity_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum purity level of the active ingredient expressed as a percentage. Critical specification parameter for quality control and formulation accuracy.

attributes.name: raw_material_code
attributes.description: Internal enterprise code used to identify and track the raw material in procurement, inventory, and manufacturing systems. Links to ERP material master records.

attributes.name: rd_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the ingredient for use in R&D formulation development. Approved ingredients are cleared for use in new product development projects.

attributes.name: regulatory_status_asean
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Status - Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the ingredient for use in cosmetic and personal care products within ASEAN member countries under the ASEAN Cosmetic Directive.

attributes.name: regulatory_status_canada

attributes.name: regulatory_status_eu

attributes.name: regulatory_status_usa

attributes.name: restricted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient has any regulatory restrictions, concentration limits, or usage conditions in any major jurisdiction. True indicates restrictions apply.

attributes.name: sds_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the Safety Data Sheet associated with this raw material. Links to the detailed safety, handling, and hazard information document.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the raw material including temperature range, humidity control, light protection, and special handling requirements (e.g., store in cool dry place, refrigerate, protect from light, inert atmosphere).

attributes.name: sustainable_sourcing_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient is sourced through certified sustainable practices (e.g., FSC, RSPO, Rainforest Alliance). True indicates sustainable sourcing certification.

attributes.name: vegan_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the ingredient is free from animal-derived components and suitable for vegan product formulations. True indicates vegan compliance.

products.name: lab_test
products.description: Records individual laboratory tests conducted on formulations or prototypes during R&D. Captures test type (stability, efficacy, microbiological, compatibility, pH, viscosity, irritation), test method reference (ISO, ASTM, internal), sample ID, test date, lab location, analyst, result value, result unit, pass/fail determination, and out-of-specification (OOS) flag. Provides the primary test execution record linking formulations to their performance data.
products.reference: Lab Test Record / QC Lab Result

attributes.name: lab_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory test record. Primary key for the lab test entity.

attributes.name: original_test_lab_test_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original laboratory test record if this is a retest. Links retest results back to the initial test for investigation tracking.

attributes.name: primary_lab_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or analyst who conducted the laboratory test.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project under which this laboratory test was conducted.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who reviewed and approved the laboratory test results.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical sample or specimen submitted for testing. Links test results to the specific batch or prototype sample.

attributes.name: analyst_name
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory analyst or technician who performed the test. Used for accountability and quality assurance purposes.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent calibration of the test equipment used. Ensures test results are obtained using properly calibrated instruments per ISO 17025 requirements.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst comments, observations, deviations, or special notes related to the test execution or results. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the laboratory test record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: lab_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where the laboratory test was conducted. May reference internal R&D labs or external contract testing laboratories.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the laboratory test record was last updated or modified. Tracks data lineage and change history for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: oos_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the test result is out of specification and requires investigation per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements. True indicates OOS condition.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Determination of whether the test result meets the specified acceptance criteria. Pass indicates compliance, fail indicates non-compliance, conditional indicates marginal results requiring review, and pending indicates awaiting final determination.

attributes.name: regulatory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this test result is required for regulatory submission or compliance purposes (FDA, EPA, EU REACH, etc.). True indicates regulatory significance.

attributes.name: result_text
attributes.description: Qualitative or descriptive result for tests that do not produce numeric values, such as visual observations, color assessments, odor evaluations, or pass/fail determinations.

attributes.name: result_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the test result value, such as pH units, cP (centipoise) for viscosity, CFU/g (colony forming units per gram) for microbial count, percentage, ppm (parts per million), or other industry-standard units.

attributes.name: result_value
attributes.description: Numeric result value obtained from the laboratory test. Represents the measured quantity or concentration of the test parameter.

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this test is a retest of a previous test, typically performed due to out-of-specification results or quality investigation. True indicates this is a retest.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the test results were reviewed and approved by quality assurance personnel.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality assurance reviewer or supervisor who verified and approved the test results. Part of the quality control review process.

attributes.name: specification_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable value for the test parameter as defined in the product specification or regulatory requirement. Used to determine pass/fail status.

attributes.name: specification_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable value for the test parameter as defined in the product specification or regulatory requirement. Used to determine pass/fail status.

attributes.name: specification_target
attributes.description: Target or ideal value for the test parameter as defined in the formulation design or product development goals.

attributes.name: stability_timepoint
attributes.description: Timepoint designation for stability testing, such as initial, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 12 months, 24 months, or 36 months. Critical for tracking product stability over time.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Environmental conditions under which the sample was stored prior to or during testing, such as room temperature, refrigerated, accelerated (40°C/75% RH), or stressed conditions. Critical for stability and shelf-life studies.

attributes.name: test_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the laboratory test execution was completed and results were recorded.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the laboratory test was performed. Critical for stability studies and time-dependent analyses.

attributes.name: test_equipment
attributes.description: Identification of the laboratory equipment or instrument used to perform the test, such as pH meter, viscometer, spectrophotometer, or microbiological incubator. Used for equipment calibration tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Standardized test method or protocol used to conduct the laboratory test. References industry standards such as ISO, ASTM, OECD, IFRA, or internal validated methods.

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the laboratory test, typically assigned by the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) or Quality Management (QM) module.

attributes.name: test_parameter
attributes.description: Specific parameter or property being measured in the test, such as pH, viscosity, microbial count, irritation index, color stability, fragrance retention, or active ingredient concentration.

attributes.name: test_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification for the laboratory test. Determines scheduling and resource allocation. Critical and regulatory tests receive highest priority.

attributes.name: test_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the laboratory test execution began. Used for time-sensitive tests and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the laboratory test. Tracks the test from scheduling through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Category of laboratory test performed. Defines the nature of the test such as stability testing, efficacy testing, microbiological testing, compatibility testing, sensory evaluation, safety assessment, physical property testing, or chemical analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stability|efficacy|microbiological|compatibility|sensory|safety|physical|chemical — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: research_stability_study
products.description: Master record for formal stability studies conducted on formulations and finished product prototypes, including all time-point measurement data. Captures study type (accelerated, real-time, freeze-thaw, photostability), ICH condition (25°C/60%RH, 40°C/75%RH, etc.), study start date, planned duration, container-closure system, orientation, study status, overall stability conclusion, and individual time-point measurements (T=0 through T=24M) with test parameters (appearance, pH, viscosity, assay, microbial count), measured values, specification limits, pass/fail status, and analyst sign-off. Supports trend analysis, shelf-life determination, and regulatory dossier preparation.
products.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Study / Stability Protocol

attributes.name: research_stability_study_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stability study record. Primary key for the research stability study entity.

attributes.name: principal_investigator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory stability study report requires linking the principal investigator (lead scientist) to an employee for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulation or finished product prototype being tested in this stability study.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality assurance manager or regulatory affairs lead who approved the final stability report.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number of the formulation being tested. Links stability data to production records.

attributes.name: chamber_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the stability chamber or environmental room where samples are stored. Used for equipment qualification tracking and data integrity.

attributes.name: color_stability_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to assess color stability. Visual for subjective assessment; colorimeter for L*a*b* values; spectrophotometer for detailed spectral analysis.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or contextual information about the stability study (e.g., unusual environmental events, protocol amendments, special handling).

attributes.name: container_closure_system
attributes.description: Description of the primary packaging system used for the stability samples (e.g., HDPE bottle with PP cap, glass jar with aluminum seal, tube with flip-top cap). Critical for assessing product-package interaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stability study record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this stability study data originated. Veeva Vault for regulatory documents; SAP QM for quality management; LIMS for laboratory data; PLM for product development; manual_entry for legacy data.

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-specification results or protocol deviations recorded during the study. Used for quality metrics and risk assessment.

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study was conducted under GMP conditions per ISO 22716 or FDA 21 CFR Part 211. Required for regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: ich_condition
attributes.description: Standardized storage condition per ICH guidelines. 25°C/60%RH is long-term for temperate climates; 30°C/65%RH for subtropical; 40°C/75%RH for accelerated testing; 5°C for refrigerated; -20°C for frozen; light_exposure for photostability; cycling for freeze-thaw. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 25C_60RH|30C_65RH|40C_75RH|5C|minus_20C|light_exposure|cycling — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inci_ingredient_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) Ingredient List
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of key active ingredients using INCI nomenclature. Used to assess ingredient stability and degradation pathways.

tag_set.value: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) Ingredient List

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stability study record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: microbial_limit_cfu_per_g
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable microbial count in colony-forming units per gram as defined in the product specification. Used to evaluate microbiological stability.

attributes.name: overall_stability_conclusion
attributes.description: Final assessment of product stability based on all time-point data. Stable indicates all parameters within specification; unstable indicates failure; marginally_stable indicates borderline performance; pending for incomplete studies.

attributes.name: ph_target_range
attributes.description: Acceptable pH range for the formulation as defined in the product specification (e.g., 5.0-6.0). Used to evaluate pH stability over time.

attributes.name: planned_duration_months
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the stability study in months. Typical values: 6 months for accelerated, 12-36 months for real-time studies.

attributes.name: preservative_system
attributes.description: Description of the antimicrobial preservative system used in the formulation. Critical for microbial stability assessment.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the product type being tested. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks and testing requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: skincare|haircare|oral_care|personal_hygiene|household_cleaning|food_contact|pharmaceutical — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recommended_shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Shelf life recommendation in months based on stability study results. Derived from trend analysis and specification compliance across time points.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stability study is intended for regulatory submission (FDA, EU REACH, etc.). True for registration dossiers; false for internal development studies.

attributes.name: report_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the stability study report was reviewed and approved by quality assurance. Marks official closure and data lock.

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the final stability study report. Used for document management and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: sample_orientation
attributes.description: Physical orientation of samples during storage. Inverted orientation tests product contact with closure; horizontal tests side-wall contact; as_marketed mimics consumer storage.

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the product specification document or quality standard used to evaluate pass/fail criteria for each test parameter.

attributes.name: storage_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of storage conditions including temperature range, humidity range, light exposure, and any special handling requirements beyond standard ICH conditions.

attributes.name: study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the final time point was tested and the study was closed. Null for in-progress studies.

attributes.name: study_objective
attributes.description: Business purpose and scientific objective of the stability study (e.g., shelf-life determination for new product launch, package compatibility assessment, reformulation validation, regulatory submission support).

attributes.name: study_protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the stability study protocol. Used for regulatory submissions and cross-referencing.

attributes.name: study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the stability study was initiated and samples were placed on stability. Marks T=0 time point.

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stability study. In_progress indicates active testing; on_hold for paused studies; completed when all time points are tested; terminated for early stoppage due to failure; cancelled for administrative closure.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stability study type. Accelerated studies use elevated temperature/humidity to predict shelf life; real-time studies use recommended storage conditions; intermediate studies bridge accelerated and real-time; freeze-thaw tests temperature cycling; photostability tests light exposure; in-use tests consumer usage conditions.

attributes.name: test_parameters
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of quality attributes measured at each time point (e.g., appearance, color, odor, pH, viscosity, specific gravity, assay, microbial count, preservative efficacy). Defines the analytical scope of the study.

attributes.name: time_point_schedule
attributes.description: Planned sampling schedule for the study (e.g., T=0, 1M, 2M, 3M, 6M, 9M, 12M, 18M, 24M). Defines when samples will be pulled and tested.

attributes.name: viscosity_target_range_cps
attributes.description: Acceptable viscosity range in centipoise (cPs) as defined in the product specification. Used to evaluate rheological stability.

products.name: stability_timepoint
products.description: Individual time-point measurement records within a stability study. Captures time-point interval (T=0, T=1M, T=3M, T=6M, T=12M, T=24M), test parameter (appearance, pH, viscosity, assay, microbial count), measured value, specification limit, pass/fail status, and analyst sign-off. Enables trend analysis across the stability study lifecycle and supports shelf-life determination and regulatory dossier preparation.

attributes.name: stability_timepoint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stability timepoint measurement record.

attributes.name: primary_stability_employee_id

attributes.name: research_stability_study_id

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the quality assurance reviewer or supervisor who verified and approved this measurement result.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the physical sample or specimen tested at this timepoint. Links to sample management and chain-of-custody records.

attributes.name: analyst_name
attributes.description: The full name of the laboratory analyst who performed this measurement. Supports traceability and quality assurance review.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing batch or lot number of the product being tested in this stability study. Critical for traceability and regulatory dossier preparation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst or reviewer observations, notes, or contextual information relevant to this timepoint measurement (e.g., sample appearance anomalies, testing conditions, procedural deviations).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timepoint measurement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_integrity_hash
attributes.description: A cryptographic hash or checksum of the measurement record to ensure data integrity and detect unauthorized modifications. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records.

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this measurement result triggered a deviation or out-of-specification (OOS) event requiring investigation.

attributes.name: deviation_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the deviation or OOS investigation record if this measurement triggered a quality event. Null if no deviation occurred.

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the laboratory instrument or equipment used to perform this measurement (e.g., pH meter serial number, viscometer ID, HPLC system ID).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timepoint measurement record was last updated or modified. Critical for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The observed result or reading obtained from the test at this timepoint. May be numeric, qualitative, or descriptive depending on the test parameter (e.g., 5.8 for pH, white for color, 3500 cP for viscosity).

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which this timepoint measurement was performed in the laboratory.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
