attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this timepoint measurement record (draft, pending review, approved, rejected, archived). Governs workflow and data release.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this measurement was a retest or repeat analysis due to initial inconclusive or failed results.

attributes.name: retest_reason
attributes.description: The documented justification or root cause for performing a retest of this measurement (e.g., instrument malfunction, analyst error, out-of-specification result requiring confirmation).

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the measurement result was reviewed and approved by the quality assurance reviewer.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: The full name of the quality assurance reviewer who verified and approved this measurement result.

attributes.name: specification_lower_limit
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for this test parameter as defined in the product specification or stability protocol. Null if no lower limit applies.

attributes.name: specification_target
attributes.description: The ideal or target value for this test parameter as defined in the product development specification. Used for trend analysis and quality control.

attributes.name: specification_upper_limit
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable value for this test parameter as defined in the product specification or stability protocol. Null if no upper limit applies.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: The environmental condition under which the sample was stored prior to this timepoint measurement (e.g., 25°C/60% RH, 40°C/75% RH, refrigerated, frozen, accelerated, long-term). attributes.name: storage_temperature_c

attributes.name: test_method_code

attributes.name: test_method_version

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measured value is expressed (e.g., pH units, cP for viscosity, % for assay, CFU/g for microbial count, mg/mL for concentration).

products.name: consumer_test
products.description: Master record for consumer and clinical use tests conducted to validate product performance, safety, and consumer acceptance. Captures study type (HUT, CLT, clinical efficacy, dermatologist test), study design, sample size, target consumer segment, test geography, test dates, primary claim being validated, overall study outcome, and individual respondent-level results including anonymized respondent ID, test panel, attribute ratings (lather, fragrance, skin feel, efficacy perception), rating scale values, open-text verbatims, claim substantiation outcomes, statistical significance flags, and net promoter intent scores. Enables claim validation, consumer insight generation, and NPD decision-making across the full test lifecycle.

products.name: sensory_evaluation
products.description: Records formal sensory panel evaluations of product prototypes and formulations. Captures panel type (trained expert panel, consumer panel, QC panel), evaluation date, product sample code, sensory attributes assessed (color, odor, texture, spreadability, rinse-off feel, after-feel), scoring methodology (QDA, hedonic scale, JAR scale), panelist count, and overall sensory profile outcome. Sensory evaluation is a distinct R&D sub-function with its own workflow and data structure.

attributes.name: sensory_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sensory evaluation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: panel_session_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific panel session, used to group multiple evaluations conducted in the same session.

attributes.name: primary_sensory_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sensory scientist or lead evaluator responsible for conducting and overseeing the evaluation session.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project under which this sensory evaluation was conducted.

attributes.name: after_feel_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the after-feel attribute, measuring the sensation after product use (e.g., moisturization, residue, stickiness).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the sensory evaluation results: pending review (awaiting review by R&D leadership), approved (results accepted for decision-making), rejected (results deemed invalid), or requires retest (evaluation must be repeated).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation results were formally approved.

attributes.name: attributes_assessed
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sensory attributes evaluated during the session (e.g., color, odor, texture, spreadability, rinse-off feel, after-feel, viscosity, foam quality, fragrance intensity).

attributes.name: benchmark_product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the benchmark or competitive product used for comparison in the evaluation, if applicable.

attributes.name: blinding_method
attributes.description: Method used to prevent bias: single-blind (panelists do not know product identity), double-blind (neither panelists nor administrators know), or open-label (product identity known).

attributes.name: color_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the color attribute, typically on a scale defined by the evaluation methodology (e.g., 1-9 scale).

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation session was completed and results finalized.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level of the evaluation results, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95% confidence).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score assessing the reliability and validity of the evaluation data, based on factors such as panelist consistency, response completeness, and adherence to protocol.

attributes.name: evaluation_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the sensory evaluation session, typically formatted as SE-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sensory evaluation panel session was conducted.

attributes.name: evaluation_methodology
attributes.description: Sensory testing methodology used: QDA (Quantitative Descriptive Analysis), hedonic scale (liking/preference), JAR scale (Just About Right), duo-trio test, triangle test, ranking, or descriptive analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qda|hedonic_scale|jar_scale|duo_trio|triangle_test|ranking|descriptive_analysis|paired_comparison|acceptance_test|discrimination_test — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing qualitative observations, panelist comments, unexpected findings, or contextual information from the evaluation session.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the sensory evaluation: scheduled (planned but not started), in progress (currently being conducted), completed (finished and results recorded), cancelled (not conducted), or on hold (temporarily paused).

attributes.name: formulation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the product formulation being tested, used to track iterations and changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensory evaluation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: odor_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the odor/fragrance attribute.

attributes.name: overall_liking_score
attributes.description: Overall hedonic score representing panelists' overall liking or preference for the product sample.

attributes.name: panel_type
attributes.description: Type of sensory panel used for the evaluation: trained expert panel (highly trained sensory experts), consumer panel (target consumers), QC panel (quality control team), internal panel (company employees), or external panel (third-party evaluators).

attributes.name: panelist_count
attributes.description: Number of panelists who participated in this sensory evaluation session.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Category of the product being evaluated (e.g., skincare, haircare, oral care, household cleaning).

attributes.name: product_sample_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the product prototype or formulation sample being evaluated. May be blinded to prevent bias.

attributes.name: purchase_intent_score
attributes.description: Score indicating panelists' likelihood to purchase the product, typically measured on a scale (e.g., 1-5 or 1-9).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sensory evaluation was conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines (e.g., FDA, EU cosmetics regulations, GMP).

attributes.name: rinse_off_feel_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the rinse-off feel attribute, relevant for products that are washed off (e.g., shampoos, body washes).

attributes.name: sensory_profile_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome classification of the sensory evaluation: acceptable (meets standards), unacceptable (fails standards), needs improvement (requires reformulation), exceeds expectations (superior performance), or benchmark equivalent (matches competitive standard).

attributes.name: spreadability_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the spreadability attribute, measuring ease of application.

attributes.name: statistical_significance
attributes.description: Indication of whether the evaluation results are statistically significant based on predefined confidence levels (e.g., p<0.05).

attributes.name: test_conditions
attributes.description: Description of environmental and procedural conditions under which the evaluation was conducted (e.g., temperature, lighting, sample presentation order).

attributes.name: test_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where the sensory evaluation was conducted (e.g., central lab, regional facility, third-party lab).

attributes.name: texture_score
attributes.description: Numerical score for the texture attribute (e.g., smoothness, creaminess, grittiness).

products.name: prototype
products.description: Master record for physical product prototypes developed during the NPD process, including associated packaging component specifications. Captures prototype code, prototype generation (P1, P2, P3), associated formulation version, packaging configuration with component-level detail (component type, material type — HDPE, PET, glass, aluminum, paperboard — dimensions, weight, closure type, decoration method, compatibility test status with formulation, recyclability classification), fill weight/volume, manufacturing scale (bench, pilot, scale-up), prototype creation date, prototype status (active, superseded, approved for consumer test), R&D packaging approval status, and the R&D project it belongs to. Prototypes are distinct from formulations — they represent the physical product iteration including packaging.

products.name: patent_filing
products.description: Master record for patent applications and granted patents arising from R&D innovation activities. Captures patent application number, patent title, filing date, jurisdiction (US, EU, JP, CN, global PCT), patent type (utility, design, composition of matter, process), inventors list, assignee, prosecution status (filed, published, granted, abandoned, expired), grant date, expiry date, and linked R&D project or formulation. Supports IP portfolio management and freedom-to-operate analysis.

attributes.name: patent_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patent filing record. Primary key for the patent filing entity.

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking related patent applications filed in multiple jurisdictions claiming the same priority. Used to track global patent family coverage.

attributes.name: primary_patent_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this patent filing record in the system. Used for audit trail and data stewardship accountability.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific formulation or composition of matter that is the subject of this patent filing. Links patent to the proprietary formula being protected.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project that generated this patent filing. Links the patent to the originating innovation initiative.

attributes.name: abstract
attributes.description: Brief technical summary of the invention as filed with the patent office. Typically 150-250 words describing the problem solved, the solution, and key technical features.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Official application number assigned by the patent office upon filing. Unique identifier used for tracking prosecution status with the patent authority.

attributes.name: assignee_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the assignee's country of incorporation or residence. Used for IP portfolio geographic analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|GBR|DEU|FRA|JPN|CHN|KOR|CAN|AUS|BRA|IND|MEX — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignee_name
attributes.description: Legal entity that owns the patent rights, typically the employer of the inventors. For Consumer Goods patents, this is usually the company name or a subsidiary.

attributes.name: backward_citations_count
attributes.description: Number of prior art patents and publications cited by this patent application. Indicates the breadth of prior art landscape and novelty assessment complexity.

attributes.name: claims_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims in the patent application. Claims define the legal scope of protection. Higher claim counts typically indicate broader or more complex inventions.

attributes.name: commercial_value_tier
attributes.description: Internal assessment of the patent's commercial importance to the business. Strategic patents protect core technologies or blockbuster products. High-value patents have clear revenue impact. Low-value or exploratory patents may be defensive or speculative.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated annual maintenance cost. Typically USD for global IP portfolio reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|KRW|CAD|AUD|BRL|INR|MXN — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cpc_class
attributes.description: Primary CPC classification code. CPC is a joint classification system developed by EPO and USPTO, providing more granular technology classification than IPC.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent filing record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_maintenance_cost
attributes.description: Projected annual cost to maintain the patent in force, including official fees, agent fees, and translation costs across all jurisdictions. Used for IP portfolio cost-benefit analysis.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date the patent protection expires, typically 20 years from filing date for utility patents. After this date, the invention enters the public domain.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date the patent application was officially filed with the patent office. Establishes priority date for novelty and non-obviousness assessment.

attributes.name: forward_citations_count
attributes.description: Number of times this patent has been cited by subsequent patent applications. High forward citation count indicates influential or foundational technology.

attributes.name: freedom_to_operate_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the patented technology can be commercialized without infringing third-party patents. Cleared indicates no blocking patents found. Risk identified or blocked indicates potential infringement issues requiring licensing or design-around.

attributes.name: grant_date
attributes.description: Date the patent was officially granted by the patent office. Marks the beginning of enforceable patent rights. Null if patent has not yet been granted.

attributes.name: independent_claims_count
attributes.description: Number of independent claims in the patent. Independent claims stand alone and define the broadest scope of protection. Typically 1-5 independent claims per patent.

attributes.name: internal_reference_code
attributes.description: Company-specific internal tracking code or docket number for the patent filing. Used for cross-referencing with R&D project records and financial systems.

attributes.name: inventors_list
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of inventors named on the patent application. Inventors are the individuals who conceived the invention. Format: LastName, FirstName; LastName, FirstName.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter code identifying the patent office jurisdiction where the patent was filed. US=United States, EP=European Patent Office, JP=Japan, CN=China, KR=South Korea, CA=Canada, AU=Australia, BR=Brazil, IN=India, MX=Mexico, RU=Russia, ZA=South Africa, PCT=Patent Cooperation Treaty (international application). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US|EP|JP|CN|KR|CA|AU|BR|IN|MX|RU|ZA|PCT — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: legal_status
attributes.description: Current legal standing of the granted patent. Active indicates patent is in force and enforceable. Lapsed indicates failure to pay maintenance fees. Revoked or invalidated indicates patent rights have been terminated by legal action.

attributes.name: licensing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patent is subject to licensing agreements. Licensed out means the company has granted rights to third parties. Licensed in means the company has acquired rights from others. Cross-licensed indicates mutual licensing with another party.
attributes.value_regex: not licensed|licensed out|licensed in|cross-licensed|available for licensing

attributes.name: maintenance_fee_due_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for payment of patent maintenance or renewal fees to keep the patent in force. Failure to pay results in patent lapse. Applicable only to granted patents in jurisdictions requiring periodic fees.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent filing record was last updated in the system. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: patent_attorney_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external law firm or patent agent representing the company for this patent filing. Used for managing outside counsel relationships and costs.

attributes.name: patent_number
attributes.description: Official patent number assigned upon grant by the patent office. Null until patent is granted. Used for citation and enforcement purposes.

attributes.name: patent_title
attributes.description: Official title of the patent as filed with the patent office. Describes the invention in concise legal language.

attributes.name: patent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the patent by legal type. Utility patents cover functional inventions, design patents cover ornamental designs, composition of matter covers chemical formulations, process covers manufacturing methods, plant covers new plant varieties, and reissue covers corrections to previously granted patents.

attributes.name: pct_application_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing was made under the Patent Cooperation Treaty, which allows a single international application to seek protection in multiple countries simultaneously.

attributes.name: pct_application_number
attributes.description: PCT international application number if this filing was made under PCT. Format: PCT/CC/YYYY/NNNNNN where CC is country code, YYYY is year, NNNNNN is serial number.

attributes.name: primary_ipc_class
attributes.description: Primary IPC classification code assigned to the patent. IPC is a hierarchical system for classifying patents by technology area. Format: Section-Class-Subclass-Group (e.g., A61K-008/00 for cosmetic preparations).

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: Earliest filing date claimed for priority purposes, typically from a provisional application or foreign filing. Used to establish prior art cutoff date.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Consumer goods product category that the patented invention applies to. Aligns with business product portfolio structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: skincare|haircare|oral care|personal hygiene|household cleaning|laundry|baby care|cosmetics|fragrances|wellness — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: prosecution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the patent application in the prosecution process. Tracks the lifecycle from drafting through grant or abandonment. Office action pending indicates examiner has issued objections requiring response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|published|under examination|office action pending|allowed|granted|abandoned|expired|withdrawn — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date the patent application was published by the patent office, typically 18 months after filing. Makes the invention publicly disclosed.

attributes.name: secondary_ipc_classes
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of additional IPC classification codes applicable to the patent. Used when invention spans multiple technology domains.

attributes.name: technology_domain
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the patent's technology area within consumer goods. Used for portfolio management and strategic IP planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: formulation|packaging|manufacturing process|delivery system|ingredient|fragrance|preservation|sustainability|biotechnology — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: regulatory_dossier
products.description: Master record for regulatory submission dossiers prepared for new product registrations and notifications. Captures dossier type (CPNP EU notification, FDA OTC monograph, ASEAN ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, Health Canada), target market, submission date, regulatory authority reference number, dossier status (in preparation, submitted, under review, approved, rejected), responsible regulatory affairs manager, and linked product/formulation. Distinct from the regulatory domain's product registration — this is the R&D-owned dossier preparation record.
products.reference: Regulatory Submission Dossier / Veeva Vault Regulatory Record

attributes.name: regulatory_dossier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory submission dossier record. Primary key for the regulatory dossier entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory affairs manager who is accountable for the preparation, submission, and management of this dossier.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id

attributes.name: rd_project_id

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: actual_approval_date

attributes.name: actual_submission_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the dossier was submitted to the regulatory authority. Null if not yet submitted.

attributes.name: additional_information_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which additional information requested by the regulatory authority must be submitted to avoid rejection or withdrawal.

attributes.name: additional_information_requested
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the regulatory authority has requested additional information or clarification on the submitted dossier.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_complete
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all allergen declarations required by the target market regulations have been completed and included in the dossier.

attributes.name: animal_testing_statement

attributes.name: authority_reference_number

attributes.name: claim_substantiation_status

attributes.name: cmr_substance_present

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory dossier record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dossier_reference_number

attributes.name: dossier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory dossier indicating its progress through the submission and approval process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: In Preparation|Ready for Review|Submitted|Under Review|Additional Information Requested|Approved|Rejected|Withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dossier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory submission dossier based on the regulatory framework and authority requirements.
attributes.value_regex: CPNP EU Notification|FDA OTC Monograph|ASEAN Cosmetic Directive|Health Canada Notification|China NMPA Registration|Australia TGA Listing

attributes.name: dossier_version
attributes.description: Version number or identifier for the dossier document, tracking revisions and updates throughout the preparation and submission process.

attributes.name: expected_approval_date
attributes.description: Estimated date for receiving regulatory approval based on standard review timelines and authority guidance.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the manufacturing facility and processes meet GMP requirements for the target market.

attributes.name: inci_listing_complete
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Listing Complete Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the complete INCI ingredient listing has been prepared and verified for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: intended_use_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intended use, application, and consumer benefits of the product as stated in the regulatory submission.

attributes.name: label_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the product labeling meets all regulatory requirements for the target market, including INCI listing, warnings, and claims.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory dossier record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: nanomaterial_present
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the product formulation contains nanomaterials, which require special regulatory notification and safety assessment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, observations, or context related to the dossier preparation, submission, or review process.

attributes.name: pif_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Product Information File document that contains all supporting documentation for the regulatory submission.

attributes.name: preparation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the preparation of the regulatory dossier was initiated by the R&D or regulatory affairs team.

attributes.name: preservative_system_approved
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the preservative system used in the formulation has been approved for use in the target market.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level product category classification (e.g., Skin Care, Hair Care, Oral Care, Personal Hygiene) for the product covered by this dossier.

attributes.name: regulatory_affairs_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the regulatory affairs contact responsible for this dossier, used for communication with regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or agency to which this dossier is submitted (e.g., FDA, European Commission, Health Canada, NMPA).

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority rejected the dossier submission. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the regulatory authority for rejecting the dossier submission, including specific deficiencies or non-compliance issues.

attributes.name: review_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority officially began their review of the submitted dossier.

attributes.name: safety_assessment_status
attributes.description: Status of the product safety assessment report required for regulatory compliance, typically prepared by a qualified safety assessor.

attributes.name: safety_assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the qualified safety assessor who prepared or reviewed the product safety assessment for this dossier.

attributes.name: submission_category
attributes.description: Category of regulatory submission indicating whether this is a new product, modification, renewal, or other type of regulatory filing.
attributes.value_regex: New Product Registration|Product Modification|Renewal|Post-Market Notification|Safety Update

attributes.name: target_market_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary target market jurisdiction for this regulatory submission.

attributes.name: target_market_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or regulatory zone for the submission (e.g., European Union, ASEAN, North America).

attributes.name: target_submission_date
attributes.description: Planned date for submitting the completed dossier to the regulatory authority, aligned with project milestones and launch timelines.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the company voluntarily withdrew the dossier from regulatory review. Null if not withdrawn.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Internal business reason for voluntarily withdrawing the dossier from regulatory review (e.g., formulation change, market strategy shift, cost considerations).

products.name: claim_substantiation
products.description: Records the evidence package assembled to substantiate specific marketing and product performance claims for regulatory and legal defense. Captures claim text (e.g., '48-hour moisturization', 'clinically proven', 'dermatologist tested'), claim type (efficacy, safety, environmental, comparative), substantiation method (clinical study, consumer test, instrumental measurement, expert endorsement), supporting study references, claim approval status, legal review sign-off, market applicability, and expiry/renewal date. Bridges R&D evidence to marketing claim usage and ensures claims are defensible under advertising standards (NAD, ASA) and regulatory requirements.
products.reference: Claim Substantiation File / FTC Claim Support Dossier

attributes.name: claim_substantiation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim substantiation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consumer_test_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer test record that provides supporting evidence for this claim.

attributes.name: primary_claim_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business owner (typically from marketing or brand management) responsible for this claim and its usage.

attributes.name: product_formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific formulation version tested to substantiate this claim.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D project that generated the evidence for this claim.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished product for which this claim is substantiated.

attributes.name: study_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal study protocol document that defines the testing methodology used for substantiation.

attributes.name: tertiary_claim_regulatory_reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory affairs specialist who reviewed this claim for compliance with applicable regulations.

attributes.name: advertising_standard_compliance
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of advertising standards and self-regulatory bodies that this claim complies with (e.g., 'NAD,ASA,ASRC,CARU').

attributes.name: challenge_history
attributes.description: Summary of any historical challenges, complaints, or disputes related to this claim from regulatory bodies, competitors, or consumer advocacy groups.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of marketing and sales channels where this claim is approved for use (e.g., 'packaging,digital,print,broadcast,retail_pos').

attributes.name: claim_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the claim substantiation within the internal governance process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|rejected|conditional_approval|withdrawn|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claim_category
attributes.description: Broader categorization of the claim for organizational and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: claim_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code assigned to this claim substantiation record for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: claim_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this claim substantiation becomes valid and the claim may be used in marketing materials.

attributes.name: claim_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this claim substantiation expires and the claim must be re-substantiated or withdrawn from use.

attributes.name: claim_text
attributes.description: The exact wording of the marketing or product performance claim being substantiated (e.g., '48-hour moisturization', 'clinically proven to reduce wrinkles', 'dermatologist tested').

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the claim based on its nature: efficacy (performance), safety (non-irritating, hypoallergenic), environmental (sustainability, eco-friendly), comparative (vs. competitor), sensory (fragrance, texture), or nutritional (for food/beverage products).

attributes.name: clinical_study_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference number for the clinical study that substantiates this claim (e.g., internal study ID, ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, published journal article DOI).

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level of the study results expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 for 95% confidence).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim substantiation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: efficacy_result_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of the key efficacy findings from the substantiation study (e.g., '87% of users reported smoother skin after 4 weeks').

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim substantiation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the legal review was completed and the claim was approved or rejected by legal counsel.

attributes.name: legal_review_status
attributes.description: Status of legal department review to ensure the claim is defensible and compliant with advertising standards.

attributes.name: market_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic markets or regions where this claim is approved for use (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR,DEU,FRA' using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes).

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next renewal or re-substantiation of this claim.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding this claim substantiation, including any special conditions or limitations on claim usage.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: Statistical p-value from hypothesis testing, indicating the probability that the observed results occurred by chance.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory review and approval for this claim, if required by governing authorities.

attributes.name: regulatory_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_claim. Business justification: Each claim substantiation feeds a regulatory claim filing; linking provides the Claim Approval Dashboard that maps substantiation evidence to claim approval status.

attributes.name: regulatory_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory review was completed.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required renewals or re-substantiation cycles for this claim.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim substantiation requires periodic renewal or re-validation.

attributes.name: risk_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the legal and regulatory risk associated with using this claim, based on strength of evidence and potential for challenge.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of subjects, panelists, or test units included in the substantiation study.

attributes.name: statistical_significance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study results achieved statistical significance at the predefined confidence level.

attributes.name: substantiation_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to substantiate this claim, including study costs, testing fees, and expert consultation fees.

attributes.name: substantiation_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the substantiation cost amount.

attributes.name: substantiation_method
attributes.description: The primary methodology used to generate evidence supporting the claim (e.g., clinical study, consumer perception test, instrumental lab measurement, expert panel review, published literature). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clinical_study|consumer_test|instrumental_measurement|expert_endorsement|literature_review|in_vitro_test|in_vivo_test|historical_data — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: supporting_document_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs, file paths, or references to all supporting evidence documents (test reports, certificates, expert opinions, published papers) that substantiate this claim.

attributes.name: test_duration_days
attributes.description: Duration of the substantiation study or test period measured in days.

products.name: innovation_brief
products.description: Formal innovation brief document that initiates an NPD project, capturing the business opportunity, target consumer, desired product benefits, cost target (COGS), RSP target, competitive benchmarks, key performance indicators, and strategic fit rationale. Serves as the contract between marketing/commercial and R&D at project inception. Distinct from the R&D project master — the brief is the upstream commercial trigger that precedes project creation.

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken

attributes.description: Type of corrective action proposed or implemented to address the product hazard. May include multiple remedies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recall|repair|replacement|refund|warning|product_modification|none_proposed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cpsc_case_number
attributes.description: Official case number assigned by CPSC upon receipt and acceptance of the filing. Used for all subsequent correspondence and tracking.

attributes.name: cpsc_response_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of CPSC response, including any requirements, recommendations, or determinations made by the agency.

attributes.name: cpsc_response_received_date
attributes.description: Date CPSC provided official response to the filing, including acceptance, request for additional information, or determination.

attributes.name: cpsc_response_type
attributes.description: Type of response received from CPSC regarding the filing. Indicates regulatory action required or determination made.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Record creation

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Technical description of the product defect or failure mode that creates the hazard. Includes root cause analysis when known.

attributes.name: fatality_count
attributes.description: Number of deaths associated with the product hazard. Triggers immediate CPSC notification and investigation.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Filing date

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Filing number

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Status

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: Type (initial, update, closure)

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit GTIN of the product involved. Global standard for product identification across supply chain.

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the product hazard, defect, or safety issue. Explains how the product can cause harm to consumers.

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Primary type of hazard posed by the product defect. Categorizes the nature of risk to consumers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fire|burn|laceration|choking|chemical_exposure|electrical_shock|fall|entrapment|suffocation|poisoning|other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incident_count
attributes.description: Total number of reported incidents involving the product hazard, including those without injury.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Incident date

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Incident description

attributes.name: injury_count
attributes.description: Number of reported injuries associated with the product hazard. Includes both confirmed and alleged injuries.

attributes.name: injury_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of injuries sustained by consumers, including medical treatment required. May include multiple incident summaries.

attributes.name: injury_severity
attributes.description: Highest severity level of injuries reported. Used to assess risk level and prioritize regulatory response.

attributes.name: injury_type
attributes.description: Injury type

attributes.name: knowledge_date
attributes.description: Date the company first obtained information reasonably supporting the conclusion that a product contains a defect which could create a substantial product hazard. Triggers 24-hour reporting obligation under Section 15(b).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Last update

attributes.name: legal_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal counsel has reviewed and approved the filing before submission. Required for Section 15(b) reports.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal counsel who reviewed the filing.

attributes.name: lot_batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the affected product units. Essential for determining scope of hazard and recall.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date_range_end
attributes.description: End date of the manufacturing period for affected product units.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date_range_start
attributes.description: Start date of the manufacturing period for affected product units.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Notes

attributes.name: population_at_risk
attributes.description: Description of consumer population particularly vulnerable to the hazard (e.g., children under 3, elderly, pregnant women). Used for targeted warnings and recalls.

attributes.name: product_defect_description
attributes.description: Defect description

attributes.name: product_model_number
attributes.description: Specific model or SKU number of the product involved in the incident. Critical for identifying affected units.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the product involved in the CPSC filing as known to consumers.

attributes.name: recall_announced_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a public recall has been announced in conjunction with this filing. True if recall press release issued.

attributes.name: recall_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date the product recall was publicly announced via CPSC press release and website posting.

attributes.name: recall_initiated
attributes.description: Recall flag

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Recall number

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the regulatory contact for official CPSC correspondence.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory affairs contact responsible for managing this filing and CPSC communications.

attributes.name: saferproducts_report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the report in the SaferProducts.gov public database if the filing resulted in a public posting.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity

attributes.name: submitted_by_email
attributes.description: Email address of the submitter for CPSC correspondence and follow-up communications.

attributes.name: submitted_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who submitted the filing to CPSC on behalf of the company.

attributes.name: supporting_document_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents attached to the filing (test reports, photos, consumer complaints, medical records, etc.).

attributes.name: units_affected
attributes.description: Units affected

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Total number of units of the affected product sold to consumers. Helps determine recall scope and consumer notification requirements.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC barcode of the product involved in the filing. Used for retail identification and tracking.

attributes.name: vault_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the document management system (Veeva Vault) where all filing documentation is stored.

attributes.name: epa_registration_id
attributes.description: Primary key

attributes.description: Reference to the internal facility master record for the manufacturing site producing this registered product. Links EPA registration to internal facility management.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Product

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory submission record that resulted in this EPA registration. Links to the submission dossier and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: active_ingredient_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of active ingredient(s) in the registered product. Each active ingredient is the chemical substance responsible for the pesticidal or antimicrobial effect. Format: Chemical Name (CAS Number); Chemical Name (CAS Number).

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Active ingredient

attributes.name: active_ingredient_percentage
attributes.description: Active ingredient %

attributes.name: annual_reporting_required
attributes.description: Annual reporting flag

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration was cancelled, either voluntarily by the registrant or involuntarily by EPA. Nullable for active registrations.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the EPA registration was cancelled. Includes voluntary cancellation reasons (e.g., product discontinuation, business decision) or involuntary reasons (e.g., safety concerns, data deficiencies, regulatory non-compliance).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this EPA registration. May include internal notes on registration strategy, EPA correspondence summaries, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: company_number
attributes.description: Five-digit EPA company number assigned to the registrant. This is the first component of the EPA registration number and identifies the company holding the registration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Record creation

attributes.name: data_call_in_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the registrant must submit data or studies in response to an EPA data call-in. Failure to meet this deadline may result in registration cancellation.

attributes.name: data_call_in_requirement
attributes.description: Description of any outstanding data call-in requirements issued by EPA. Data call-ins require registrants to submit additional studies or data to support continued registration. Includes requirement reference number and due date.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration becomes legally effective and the product may be manufactured, distributed, and sold under this registration.

attributes.name: epa_establishment_number
attributes.description: EPA establishment number identifying the facility where the product is manufactured. Format: Company Number-State Code-Facility Number (e.g., 12345-CA-001). Required on product labels.

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA registration number

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the EPA registration expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Nullable for registrations without a fixed expiration (subject to periodic review).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Physical form and delivery method of the registered product. Determines packaging, application method, and handling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: liquid|aerosol|wipe|powder|granular|tablet|gel|paste|ready_to_use|concentrate — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: label_approval_date
attributes.description: Label approval date

attributes.name: label_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the EPA-approved product label. The label must be approved before the product can be marketed. Approved = label accepted by EPA, Pending Review = submitted awaiting EPA review, Conditionally Approved = approved with minor changes required, Rejected = label not acceptable, Revision Required = EPA requested changes.

attributes.name: label_approved
attributes.description: Label approved

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the currently approved EPA label. Used to track label revisions and ensure correct label is in use for manufacturing and distribution.

attributes.name: last_annual_report_date
attributes.description: Last report date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Last update

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renewal action for this EPA registration. Used to track renewal history and calculate next renewal due date.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next renewal application must be submitted to EPA to maintain continuous registration status. Critical for compliance planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Notes

attributes.name: product_brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial brand name under which the product is marketed to consumers. May differ from the registered product name.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: EPA product classification category based on intended use and target pest. Antimicrobial = broad-spectrum microbial control, Disinfectant = kills bacteria/viruses on surfaces, Sanitizer = reduces microbial load, Insecticide = controls insects, Rodenticide = controls rodents, Fungicide = controls fungi, Herbicide = controls weeds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: antimicrobial|disinfectant|sanitizer|insecticide|rodenticide|fungicide|herbicide — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Official product name as registered with EPA. This is the name that appears on the approved label and in EPA databases.

attributes.name: product_use_category
attributes.description: Use category

attributes.name: registrant_name
attributes.description: Registrant name

attributes.name: registrant_number
attributes.description: Registrant number

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Registration date

attributes.name: registration_review_case_number
attributes.description: EPA case number for the periodic registration review process. EPA reviews all pesticide registrations on a 15-year cycle to ensure they continue to meet safety standards.

attributes.name: registration_review_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when EPA issued the most recent registration review decision for this product. Used to track compliance with periodic review requirements.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Status

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Type (pesticide, antimicrobial)

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary regulatory affairs contact for this EPA registration. Used for internal coordination and EPA correspondence tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory affairs contact responsible for managing this EPA registration. Internal point of contact for registration maintenance and EPA correspondence.

attributes.name: reregistration_eligibility_decision
attributes.description: EPA determination of whether the product is eligible for reregistration under updated safety and environmental standards. Eligible = meets current standards, Ineligible = does not meet standards and requires reformulation or cancellation, Pending = under EPA review, Not Applicable = not subject to reregistration.

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: Required signal word on the product label indicating relative acute toxicity. Danger = highest toxicity (Category I), Warning = moderate toxicity (Category II), Caution = lower toxicity (Category III), None = minimal toxicity (Category IV).

attributes.name: target_pest_list
attributes.description: List of target pests, pathogens, or organisms that the product is registered to control (e.g., bacteria, viruses, mold, ants, cockroaches). Defines the approved efficacy claims.

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: EPA classification determining who may purchase and apply the product. General Use = available to general public, Restricted Use = requires certified applicator due to potential hazards to environment or applicator.

attributes.name: use_site_description
attributes.description: Description of approved use sites and application locations for the registered product (e.g., household surfaces, food contact surfaces, hospitals, schools, outdoor residential). Defines where the product may legally be applied.

attributes.name: vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the EPA registration documents stored in the regulatory document vault system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Links to approved labels, safety data sheets, and registration correspondence.

domains.name: sustainability
domains.description: Owns environmental, social, and governance (ESG) data. Manages carbon footprint tracking, packaging recyclability metrics, FSC/RSPO sustainable sourcing certifications, ISO 14001 environmental compliance, water and energy consumption records, waste reduction programs, circular economy initiatives, and ESG reporting obligations for regulatory and investor disclosure.

products.name: esg_commitment
products.description: Master record for Consumer Goods formal ESG commitments, targets, and pledges. Captures commitment type (carbon neutrality, net-zero, water stewardship, zero-waste-to-landfill, deforestation-free), target year, baseline year and value, target value, measurement unit, commitment owner, governing body alignment (SBTi, UN Global Compact, RE100), public disclosure status, and progress tracking cadence. Serves as the authoritative registry linking to periodic commitment_progress records for time-series tracking. Referenced by esg_disclosure for external reporting.

products.name: carbon_emission
products.description: Transactional record of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions measured or calculated at the facility, production line, product, or supply chain activity level. Captures emission date, emission source category (Scope 1 direct combustion, Scope 2 purchased energy, Scope 3 upstream/downstream), activity type (manufacturing, logistics, raw material extraction, packaging), CO2e quantity in metric tonnes, calculation methodology (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064), emission factor applied, data quality flag, and verification status. Primary operational record for carbon footprint tracking and CDP/GRI reporting.

Captures incident date and time, facility or location reference, incident type (chemical spill, air emission exceedance, wastewater discharge violation, soil contamination), severity classification, quantity and substance released, regulatory notification requirement flag, notification date, corrective action plan reference, root cause category, and closure date. Supports EPA/OSHA regulatory reporting and ISO 14001 nonconformance management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`_metrics`.`consumer_cltv_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Customer lifetime value metrics for predictive revenue modeling and customer segmentation"
  source: "`vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`consumer`.`cltv_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "cltv_tier"
      expr: cltv_tier
      comment: "Customer lifetime value tier classification"
    - name: "calculation_status"
      expr: calculation_status
      comment: "Status of the CLTV calculation"
    - name: "primary_channel"
      expr: primary_channel
      comment: "Primary purchase channel for the customer"
    - name: "primary_brand_code"
      expr: primary_brand_code
      comment: "Primary brand purchased by the customer"
    - name: "primary_category_code"
      expr: primary_category_code
      comment: "Primary product category purchased by the customer"
    - name: "nps_category"
      expr: nps_category
      comment: "Net Promoter Score category (promoter, passive, detractor)"
    - name: "calculation_date"
      expr: calculation_date
      comment: "Date the CLTV was calculated"
    - name: "calculation_year"
      expr: YEAR(calculation_date)
      comment: "Year of CLTV calculation"
    - name: "calculation_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', calculation_date)
      comment: "Month of CLTV calculation"
    - name: "tier_change_flag"
      expr: tier_change_flag
      comment: "Whether the customer changed CLTV tier in this period"
    - name: "personalization_eligible"
      expr: personalization_eligible
      comment: "Whether the customer is eligible for personalized marketing"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Customers Scored"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT shopper_id)
      comment: "Total unique customers with CLTV scores"
    - name: "Avg CLTV Score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cltv_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average customer lifetime value score"
    - name: "Total CLTV Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cltv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total predicted customer lifetime value across all customers"
    - name: "Avg Predicted Revenue 12M"
      expr: AVG(CAST(predicted_revenue_12m AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average predicted revenue over next 12 months"
    - name: "Total Predicted Revenue 12M"
      expr: SUM(CAST(predicted_revenue_12m AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total predicted revenue over next 12 months"
    - name: "Avg Churn Probability"
      expr: AVG(CAST(churn_probability AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average probability of customer churn"
    - name: "Avg Purchase Frequency"
      expr: AVG(CAST(purchase_frequency AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average purchase frequency per customer"
    - name: "Avg AOV"
      expr: AVG(CAST(aov AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average order value per customer"
    - name: "Tier Change Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN tier_change_flag = TRUE THEN cltv_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(cltv_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of customers who changed CLTV tier"
    - name: "Personalization Eligible Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN personalization_eligible = TRUE THEN cltv_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(cltv_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of customers eligible for personalized marketing"
$$
metric_views.description: Customer lifetime value metrics for predictive revenue modeling and customer segmentation

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`_metrics`.`consumer_consent_record`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Privacy consent and compliance metrics for GDPR, CCPA, and data governance"
  source: "`vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`consumer`.`consent_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "consent_status"
      expr: consent_status
      comment: "Current consent status (granted, withdrawn, expired)"
    - name: "consent_type"
      expr: consent_type
      comment: "Type of consent (marketing, data processing, profiling, etc.)"
    - name: "legal_basis"
      expr: legal_basis
      comment: "Legal basis for data processing (consent, legitimate interest, contract, etc.)"
    - name: "consent_scope"
      expr: consent_scope
      comment: "Scope of the consent (email, SMS, profiling, third-party sharing, etc.)"
    - name: "capture_method"
      expr: capture_method
      comment: "Method by which consent was captured"
    - name: "country_code"
      expr: country_code
      comment: "Country where consent was captured"
    - name: "regulatory_jurisdiction"
      expr: regulatory_jurisdiction
      comment: "Regulatory jurisdiction (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)"
    - name: "consent_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('DAY', consent_timestamp)
      comment: "Date consent was granted"
    - name: "consent_year"
      expr: YEAR(consent_timestamp)
      comment: "Year consent was granted"
    - name: "consent_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', consent_timestamp)
      comment: "Month consent was granted"
    - name: "double_opt_in_flag"
      expr: double_opt_in_flag
      comment: "Whether double opt-in was used"
    - name: "parental_consent_flag"
      expr: parental_consent_flag
      comment: "Whether parental consent was obtained (for minors)"
    - name: "third_party_sharing_flag"
      expr: third_party_sharing_flag
      comment: "Whether consent includes third-party data sharing"
    - name: "is_current_record"
      expr: is_current_record
      comment: "Whether this is the current active consent record"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Consent Records"
      expr: COUNT(consent_record_id)
      comment: "Total number of consent records"
    - name: "Total Unique Shoppers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT shopper_id)
      comment: "Total unique shoppers with consent records"
    - name: "Consent Grant Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN consent_status = 'GRANTED' THEN consent_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(consent_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consent records with granted status"
    - name: "Consent Withdrawal Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN consent_status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN consent_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(consent_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consent records that have been withdrawn"
    - name: "Double Opt-In Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN double_opt_in_flag = TRUE THEN consent_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(consent_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents using double opt-in verification"
    - name: "Third-Party Sharing Consent Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN third_party_sharing_flag = TRUE THEN consent_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(consent_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents that include third-party data sharing"
    - name: "Parental Consent Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN parental_consent_flag = TRUE THEN consent_record_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(consent_record_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of consents requiring parental approval"
$$
metric_views.description: Privacy consent and compliance metrics for GDPR, CCPA, and data governance

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`_metrics`.`consumer_dtc_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Direct-to-consumer order metrics for revenue, conversion, and fulfillment performance"
  source: "`vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`consumer`.`dtc_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "order_status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of the order (e.g., pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled)"
    - name: "fulfillment_status"
      expr: fulfillment_status
      comment: "Fulfillment status of the order"
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Payment status of the order"
    - name: "channel_code"
      expr: channel_code
      comment: "Sales channel through which the order was placed"
    - name: "device_type"
      expr: device_type
      comment: "Device type used to place the order (e.g., mobile, desktop, tablet)"
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method used for the order"
    - name: "order_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('DAY', order_date)
      comment: "Date the order was placed"
    - name: "order_year"
      expr: YEAR(order_date)
      comment: "Year the order was placed"
    - name: "order_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)
      comment: "Month the order was placed"
    - name: "gift_order_flag"
      expr: gift_order_flag
      comment: "Whether the order is a gift order"
    - name: "subscription_order_flag"
      expr: subscription_order_flag
      comment: "Whether the order is part of a subscription"
    - name: "return_flag"
      expr: return_flag
      comment: "Whether the order has been returned"
  measures:
    - name: "Total Orders"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT dtc_order_id)
      comment: "Total number of direct-to-consumer orders"
    - name: "Total Order Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(order_total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross merchandise value of all orders"
    - name: "Total Subtotal Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subtotal_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total subtotal amount before shipping and tax"
    - name: "Total Shipping Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(shipping_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total shipping charges across all orders"
    - name: "Total Tax Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount collected"
    - name: "Total Discount Amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount amount applied to orders"
    - name: "Avg Order Value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(order_total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average order value across all orders"
    - name: "Return Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN return_flag = TRUE THEN dtc_order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dtc_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders that have been returned"
    - name: "Subscription Order Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN subscription_order_flag = TRUE THEN dtc_order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dtc_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders that are subscription-based"
    - name: "Gift Order Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gift_order_flag = TRUE THEN dtc_order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dtc_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders that are gift orders"
    - name: "Avg Discount Per Order"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount amount per order"
    - name: "Discount Penetration Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN discount_amount > 0 THEN dtc_order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dtc_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders that received a discount"
$$
metric_views.description: Direct-to-consumer order metrics for revenue, conversion, and fulfillment performance

    - name: "transaction_date"

      comment: "Date the transaction occurred"

      expr: YEAR(transaction_date)
      comment: "Year of the transaction"

      expr: COUNT(loyalty_transaction_id)

    - name: "Total Points Issued"

    - name: "Total Points Redeemed"

      comment: "Total loyalty points redeemed by customers"

      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN points_direction = 'CREDIT' THEN points_amount WHEN points_direction = 'DEBIT' THEN -points_amount ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "Total Monetary Value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(monetary_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monetary value of loyalty transactions"
    - name: "Avg Points Per Transaction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(points_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average points per transaction"
    - name: "Redemption Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN points_direction = 'DEBIT' THEN points_amount ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN points_direction = 'CREDIT' THEN points_amount ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of issued points that have been redeemed"
    - name: "Fraud Transaction Rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN fraud_flag = TRUE THEN loyalty_transaction_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(loyalty_transaction_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of transactions flagged for fraud"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`_metrics`.`manufacturing_batch_record`
WITH METRICS

AS $$

  comment: "Batch-level manufacturing KPIs tracking yield, quality, cost, and regulatory compliance for batch production steering and GMP audit readiness."
  source: "`vibe_consumer_goods_v1`.`manufacturing`.`batch_record`"
  dimensions:

      expr: release_status

      expr: manufacturing_facility_id
      comment: "Manufacturing facility where the batch was produced"
    - name: "production_line_id"
      expr: production_line_id
      comment: "Production line used for the batch"
    - name: "sku_id"
      expr: sku_id
      comment: "SKU produced in the batch"
    - name: "brand_id"
      expr: marketing_brand_id
      comment: "Brand associated with the batch"
    - name: "gmp_compliant"
      expr: gmp_compliant_flag
      comment: "Whether the batch is GMP compliant"
    - name: "gmp_deviation_occurred"
      expr: gmp_deviation_flag
      comment: "Whether any GMP deviation occurred during batch production"
    - name: "quality_released"
      expr: quality_release_flag
      comment: "Whether the batch has been released by quality"
    - name: "recall_flagged"
      expr: recall_flag
      comment: "Whether the batch is flagged for recall"
    - name: "regulatory_hold"
      expr: regulatory_hold_flag
      comment: "Whether the batch is under regulatory hold"
    - name: "manufacture_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', manufacture_date)
      comment: "Month when the batch was manufactured"
    - name: "release_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', release_date)
      comment: "Month when the batch was released"
  measures:
    - name: "total_batches"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of batch records"
    - name: "total_batch_size_planned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(batch_size_planned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned batch size across all batches"
    - name: "total_batch_size_actual"
      expr: SUM(CAST(batch_size_actual AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual batch size produced"
    - name: "total_rework_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rework_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity requiring rework"
    - name: "total_scrap_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scrap_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total scrap quantity generated"
    - name: "total_actual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual cost incurred for batch production"
    - name: "total_standard_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(standard_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total standard cost for batch production"
    - name: "avg_yield_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(yield_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average yield percentage across batches"
    - name: "avg_oee_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(oee_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Overall Equipment Effectiveness percentage"
    - name: "batch_yield_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(batch_size_actual AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size_planned AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of planned batch size that was actually produced"
    - name: "rework_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(rework_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size_actual AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of actual production requiring rework"
    - name: "scrap_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(scrap_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(batch_size_actual AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of actual production that became scrap"
    - name: "cost_variance_amount"
      expr: SUM((CAST(actual_cost_amount AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(standard_cost_amount AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total cost variance (actual minus standard cost)"
    - name: "gmp_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN gmp_compliant_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batches that are GMP compliant"
    - name: "gmp_deviation_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN gmp_deviation_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batches with GMP deviations"
    - name: "quality_release_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_release_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batches released by quality"
    - name: "recall_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN recall_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of batches flagged for recall"
$$
metric_views.description: Batch-level manufacturing KPIs tracking yield, quality, cost, and regulatory compliance for batch production steering and GMP audit readiness.

      comment: "Month when production was planned to end"

      comment: "Month when production actually ended"

    - name: "total_production_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of production orders"

      expr: SUM(CAST(order_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned production quantity across all orders"
    - name: "total_confirmed_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(confirmed_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total confirmed production quantity delivered"
    - name: "total_scrap_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scrap_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total scrap quantity generated across orders"
    - name: "total_planned_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned production cost"
    - name: "total_actual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual production cost incurred"
    - name: "avg_yield_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(yield_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average yield percentage across production orders"
    - name: "avg_oee_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(oee_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Overall Equipment Effectiveness percentage"
    - name: "order_fill_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(confirmed_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(order_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)

    - name: "scrap_rate"

    - name: "cost_variance_amount"
      expr: SUM((CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(planned_cost AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total cost variance (actual minus planned cost)"
    - name: "gmp_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN gmp_compliance_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of production orders that are GMP compliant"
$$
